## Frisco Teen Fatally Stabbed at Track Meet
A 17-year-old Frisco ISD student was [fatally stabbed](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00DGPozAQBeBfY7qJBjMEKCiuodtrr4zG9jgZxUBkO8vm35-SfusnfU_v_fu6fLEm3a5_eZW5_sT9YtH2gARIl8CaXhdqwuwwTG0jcztQN5yJ7NDcZhfdKNOIKHFw1iM6N44tobOTJx66Ruc3hoTUYj-2_Sl20k5e2skxYRQ0hBK07vlUb1Llh0tMr_1b8snva5PmW62PYro_xi7GLsdxnI7I_A6NXThX9UmMXTY5irFL2j0nY5eYtfgdPh5oCVAz-zusIhXKszxkCxJAVslX2fwLdPMaZKtQ_G3fIWipWX2F-_N1ly1wSlAqB32-W-04wLkbcep7D4JdAGJxMHZDBMbou5bp7AmbPIfHoSlpOQ-G8Lqyps-s-uvP37P9HwAA__-crYD7) at a track meet Wednesday morning. Austin Metcalf, a junior at Memorial High School, [reportedly confronted another student](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L_OozAQBPCnMd1GxpiACxfX0H3XXonW9jpYMTjCmz-8_Yn0XzPNSD-N5t_P_IMpp-32F1ey_IllVlL1IDVIPQdM-Zh1E6yTwbQN2XbQ3XDVWg3NYkcZg3bBjTi4Yeyiid4PV2OM8r2RnWqSPTGppW5lP7b9JXbUGk-tcahlJCm0pJC47BdeiOmDNeajvGi_-LI22S7Mjyq6P0JNQk3b8SiVz0qo6ZSFmqQ-oxNqelbY6F2Fmr4QMNEG-KycNliJPeYIERlzPqAyOkcB3AF33FfKBXDjpWwHIMOSbgtUv5SSgXf0d1iJWKip2W14vFPOqV4HoeVtxZS_U_nX715W_Q8AAP__PFFyNQ) about being in the wrong seat before he was stabbed. Police arrested 17-year-old Karmelo Anthony, a senior at a different high school, for the alleged murder. His bond was set at $1 million. Metcalf reportedly [died in his twin brother’s arms](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvgzAQRn-N2Yxsc-B48NCFLV07IoPPyakGInyNk39f0b3bN3x6T3pf1-kaKNN2-wwren6lfTLK9FKBVDDFQPk9QRP9rKLTDXptobMDgLHN3Ts3XJZkBm1N15uYhpg662YXZ3tBNKkhf8IUKNCqv-i-TR1qt6B2cwCVUAlQGIn3o-U7Mr5CSfm9P_Fol31tsr8zP4roPoQZhRlrrW3aX7BhLedBmPGcwozhpzBtckVeQk6SK20yHVSWXfIRlm-5IrIsHOaZtltz-PiolDOVwQpQtzVQ_jPyvwme3vwGAAD__6u5YEc). The meet was suspended and has been rescheduled for Monday at a different location. Metcalf was a star linebacker who was recently voted his team’s Most Valuable Player, according to a [GoFundMe organized by his father](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0j7GOhCAUAL8GOwzgU5aC4hq7vfZKg_KQl4BslF3Xv7_s9ddPZjI_9-nuKNG2fruMtr5DmZRQPRfABUzeUbomaLydhTeyQSs1dHoAULqJdkaUYb4NAFrJzgxagTdBi6U3wZneN2Q_MgECpOhvsm9Dh9IsKM3sQAQUDAR6qmVva8SKb3eEdJUX7u1ScpNsrPVxsO6LqZGp8TzPdi3hufmMH4CpMTA1xrKVnbaVu-dRaeMZ6-JS4BHTg0c6eHCZ0sUjutTs1j9OSomOQTMQa3aU_mL13_uXVb8BAAD__4ObXeY). “ _He was a bright young man with a great future ahead of him_ ,” Jeff Metcalf said. “ _We will all remember him for the way he impacted others’ lives_.”
## 13 Texas James Beard Awards Finalists
Thirteen Texas restaurants made the cut as [finalists for this year’s James Beard Awards](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLuOrDAMhp8mdBk5wcOlSHGadHPaLZEhzpBVIIhkbm-_Am27jQv716fP_9dtuFGIYb3_p4VNefs0aNBXCSgBB0chfgasnBnB9apio1qs2wZRt9VsuGk7308dQuNU0zUeNU3t2HSuHlsCrII5YICACq6dul58zaqfWPUjIXgGgcAulLRfysyF35R9_KQn75cpLVU0cylbFvU_oa3QNm88lf2xxDRRXPmVj5TQtryPY3qUWZ4MyVFulJPQ9kgJbQ8NoS3gMWqh7TctnOXItDtJL9pdluff67lX9S_Ih5ViyCVXu3HbK8QYctMKhPtCIZ6S5c_Wnkb_BAAA__9RQ26O), which will be announced this summer in Chicago. Earlier this year, 40 Texas restaurants were named as semifinalists. [In Dallas](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LFy8yAQBOCnQR2aAx2SVVD8jTr_bUrNSRw2GSQ8gC377TNx0qb_Zmd3P87zmUIM--U_bWzr06dZgzYSUALOjkJ8zdg4u4AbVcNWDdgNPaIemqtdF-dJderEZkCCHsxA5PwIaMzJLLoJ9jsMEFCBOSnT-o7VuLIaF0LwDAKBXagpt_XKlZ9UfHylB-d2TVsT7bXWWxHdP6EnoafjOFpHMVJJS-H8y4SeMpdK90x7LUJP7wE_Tn7SxkUuTNlJH3aKodQiad_TfV_ZSa0BdQ-qydbdjhBjKP0gEC4bhfguUf985WH1VwAAAP__w4plVQ), Japanese restaurant Mābo is a finalist for Best New Restaurant, Starship Bagel is a finalist for Outstanding Bakery, and Bar Colette is a finalist for Best New Bar. Regino Rojas at Mexican restaurant Purépecha is a finalist for Best Chef in Texas. [In the Houston area](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFuhDAQRL_GdEZrYzAULtLQXdqUaIH14cjAyV6Ou7-PiNKmmWI0enqar9twwxDDdv_ElRy__D5o0LUEI8EMM4b4HkwxuxHmThXklDWVbYzRtlgcjkS-RVu3toVOgyVqp642VTc1yjdtEdwFAwNGQd2quvQVqW4i1Y1owBMIAzQH3lPJCzG9MPv43p-Uymlfi-gW5kcW1YfQvdD9sh-Z962cjshHohUf10zofqMzC90nyoxHwo2zHDFd1TeulOVImGaJ55U-bBhD5iz_cPJyFLovkpsfZ4gx5MYKA_cVQ_z14H-PeTr9EwAA__9X32dj), bakery and cafe Ema is a finalist for Best New Restaurant. Two area chefs are finalists for Best Chef in Texas: Emmanuel Chavez at Mexican restaurant Tatemó and Thomas Bille at Belly of the Beast in Spring. Other finalists for Best Chef in Texas are Emil Oliva at Peruvian restaurant Leche de Tigre [in San Antonio](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO3CAQQL_G7mYFGBu7oEjj7tKmtAYz2JNgWAFZ7_19dOmvf3p6er8-tg_kyOn4iRfZ9g55U0KNIDQIvXnk-Lnp3lsn_CJ7stLowUxaK9Of1k3jQMts5nl2OC8yCD-JicLinCGHvmf7JRNaaCnGWY6PMJBcdpKLQy0CiU4L8txyebSTGr2xhviZX1Qee776aM_WnrUbfnRq7dR63_ej4v63FErti-jUGnL24AunP51aKybA1HLiDJ4TpwPqM7cKkfaTwBM0PgoBJg8Xv1tkQP_CtBNghd94UQVHWDwEThi5tgqDkVqaRfbF-ufNMXKdTKfFcSHH_5nt228vq_4FAAD__0Ctcso) and Michael Anthony Serva at Italian deli Bordo, in Marfa.
## Elephants in Houston
An art installation featuring [100 life-sized elephant sculptures](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2OgzAQBp_GdI7sjQmhcHENXa69Ei14jVdncASbH97-RPqrv9F80vzc-hty5mX6xpm8vGPpwUCtjdPG9QE5772rgh9MaG1F3jbu3Fycg6ZKvm0HGyFCcCNgM1xiG2wN0RCG63UAW7E_ZMYZZ019tfUpnsm2I9l2QGciGeUMBZayniSR0Bu3mPfypPU0lrnKPoncN3X-UtAp6D5A4im9cN8OQkE3PrI8VjrWRHpaCUVTpnvCRfTM04rCZdGCv7xM-lDrVB6blEVBV60-3F-cM2-XRjkzzcj5cy3_tnh6-AsAAP__pHhkGA) is on display in Houston’s Hermann Park through the end of the month. Houston is one of seven U.S. cities—and the only one in Texas—where the Great Elephant Migration is scheduled to make a stop. Created by 200 artists from India’s Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve, the sculptures are made from dried lantana plants, an invasive plant harming elephant habitats. Some of the elephants are [available for sale](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0j7Fu7CAQAL8Gd7YWvBzPBcVr3F3alNZiFoyEjYXJ5e7vo0RKmX40o3m_L3dKOR3xjXa27RnKokDpHrAHXDyl_Fqw89aBn2THVhoczQ1RmW6zKxjNQWlnPKgVx5GMMugCag7OT9Al-y0DBJSg_0k9hJHltLKcHCEEBoHAPrVSh7Zx4yddIb_Kg-uwlr3LdmvtvMT4X6hZqLltHCtT48znRkfbU6zUUjmGUqNQ80mRL6Fm9_Hq6eh_sa5af36mnNN1MwIh7pTyT6D9efyw6isAAP__iOdaRA). “ _The Great Elephant Migration is more than an art installation—it is a call to action and a place to experience joy_ ,” [said Cara Lambright](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLuO5SAQBb8GZ1jQtB8EBJs4m003tNrQ2GjwQ5g7nvn71d18oxMcqVSqPx_zB6WcjvU37ezqdzxnUNBJhVLhHCjlnxmb4BYVrG7Y6QHN0CPC0GwO0Vjvowl9FwOMnvoYqB-1seMSfIhNcm-YQoVadaPu2mhYW8_aLoQqshKoOKR6lrZuXPmb7ph_zi8urT_3Jrut1usW5peAScD0PE_7uZ2v9ylgolKTzyxgikz1VfgWMK2FqUrOfG10VLmntVBN5yG383XX93LZ6TjkReVTwARjJztC461Hqc2oJCJ4afUCMiwdqMEAW7s0xYXrSTmnux8EqnWnlP9Z1v9m-3LwNwAA___TnW68), president and CEO of Hermann Park Conservancy. # [Jimmy Carter was the first U.S. president born in a hospital.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=su6xnd&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [Famous Figures](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=su6xnd&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=su6xnd&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| T he majority of U.S. presidents were born in their parents’ homes, as it wasn’t until the early 20th century that hospital births became common throughout the United States. In fact, the [first president born in a hospital](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=su6xnd&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) was Jimmy Carter, on October 1, 1924. America’s 39th president (who served as commander in chief from 1977 to 1981) was born at the Wise Sanitarium in Plains, Georgia, where his mother, Lillian Carter, worked as a nurse at the time.

## Martin Van Buren was the first president born a U.S. citizen.
From George Washington through Andrew Jackson, America’s first seven presidents were born as British subjects, before the adoption of the Declaration of Independence in 1776. Martin Van Buren, who came into the world on December 5, 1782, was the first U.S. president born after America declared independence from Britain, and thus the [first president born a U.S. citizen](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=su6xnd&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com). Van Buren was raised in the Dutch community of Kinderhook, New York; in fact, Dutch was Van Buren’s first language, making him the only president to learn English as a second language. He was elected to the presidency in 1836 and served a single term before being succeeded by William Henry Harrison. Born in 1773, Harrison was older than Van Buren and was the last U.S. president born before the country’s independence.

The good news is that parents are waking up and taking action to remove controversial material from their children’s schools. We’re grateful for that, but now they need a trustworthy book fair experience.

**That’s why books found at SkyTree Book Fairs celebrate great storytelling, classic values, and the principles that make for strong families and communities.**

Our goal is to reach 150,000 students this year with our SkyTree Book Fair experience. I’m asking for your help to put more wholesome books into the hands of kids across America.

As more parents wake up and take action, they are demanding greater access to literature that lets imaginations soar while building strong moral character.

**When a school partners with SkyTree Book Fairs, parents, grandparents, teachers, and librarians alike can trust that _every_ title at a SkyTree book fair has been carefully screened to ensure it contains no sexually explicit content or storylines that promote gender confusion.**

---

---
[**DONATE TO MY HUSBAND’S SENATE CAMPAIGN**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zgb0k0b1fe6mlnjsk4okt43tji8biampj48aonp0_rp22sh2s8i6eob6ctgeap36chh2bs)
---
You see, many people __**THINK**__ they know Derrick’s story based on the headlines and newspapers. _“January 6th Insurrectionist.”_ _“Redneck from West Virginia.”_ The media is going to say what it wants. But I know the real Derrick, and _I want you to know him too_. Derrick was my college sweetheart. He was one of the few **pro-life conservatives** I met on campus—passionate, kind, and full of conviction.
---
[](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zfmpcf6cgs3egsg089ugecdl4seqnaqedp47g7a0_rp22sh2s8i6eob6ctgeap36chh2bs)
---
When we got married, we lived a normal American life. We had kids running around. Derrick was working on homes, helping out at the family ranch, even volunteering at rehab facilities across West Virginia – __a state ripped apart by opioids and alcoholism__. On top of running for local office, he also helped coached D1 football. Beyond the wins and losses, he wanted to teach young men how to __be good fathers, American__ ____patriots, and strong leaders__. But that all changed in a blink of an eye. **The life Derrick created for our family was** **FLIPPED UPSIDE DOWN OVERNIGHT.** **A SWAT team of Biden's FBI agents****busted down our front door. ** The kids were screaming. Derrick had his hands up. **I was CONFUSED, living in a NIGHTMARE.** Then I remembered – _Derrick went to Washington DC on January 6th to PEACEFULLY contest a stolen election_. _That’s what this was all about_. The Biden Regime labeled him an “insurrectionist” and that was it. **My husband was going to prison.** We tried to fight back. We argued entrapment. We argued violation of free speech. Nothing worked. The courts REFUSED to hear it. **Derrick’s fate was SEALED. ** He would be spending his nights in a cold, dark prison cell. I would be laying in bed alone wondering how I'm going to take care of four kids by myself. Months later, when Derrick was released on good behavior, _the man I saw come home was different_. He always had an interest in politics, _but going to prison lit a fire inside of him I had never seen before_.
---
[](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z4ikdn4v8m9dh02pgnp3t5p7o3k6vn0gmacd3tlg_rp22sh2s8i6eob6ctgeap36chh2bs)
---
So when Derrick found out he was PARDONED by President Trump, and was now eligible to run for U.S. Senate, _that’s immediately what he decided to do_. **I support him 100%. ** _Do you?_
---
[**DONATE TO MY HUSBAND'S CAMPAIGN**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zk2joief5h0ip6be83t8jhocn86l3oebfklcl31g_rp22sh2s8i6eob6ctgeap36chh2bs)
---
This isn’t about “revenge” for Derrick. This is about justice. Justice for the **HUNDREDS** of Americans who were entrapped and imprisoned on Jan 6th. Justice for young girls like Laken Riley who were **MURDERED** by Joe Biden’s illegal aliens. Justice for our police officers, first responders, and military heroes who were **FIRED** over vaccine mandates. Justice for our coal miners and blue collar workers – right here in states like West Virginia – who’ve seen their livelihoods **SHIPPED** overseas. Now, I don’t know a whole lot about politics, but I know this: **Derrick’s running for Senate to look out for America's future – to look out for the people who have been IGNORED by the politicians for too long. ****He calls it the “Swamp”. ** Bottom line: _he needs your help to WIN_.
---
[**HELP MY HUSBAND WIN HIS CAMPAIGN**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zb8ls3n58thbhm2ehm72tcdbk1d0ii216h7uonpo_rp22sh2s8i6eob6ctgeap36chh2bs)
---

Because while they sip martinis and discuss billion-dollar deals with megadonors, Derrick is out in the field talking to the people who matter most:**__Americans like YOU__**. Your support would mean so much to him. **I keep telling him he’s doing a great job, but nothing makes his day more than seeing[patriots like you chip into his campaign ](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zlt54sugptkhbspgi6ig8bugu25mbp8fb6e8htog_rp22sh2s8i6eob6ctgeap36chh2bs)** **[$5, $10, $15, $20 at a time](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z0catcimfqqj7g3jh1bksrp7perg0c8ev6nagfj0_rp22sh2s8i6eob6ctgeap36chh2bs)[](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zark8655pdna7oqi3313vsojf5k2d60kouvlrufg_rp22sh2s8i6eob6ctgeap36chh2bs)[](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zdfl46qphemjrc668vch2fhujjtttl2qtecgunro_rp22sh2s8i6eob6ctgeap36chh2bs).** Every dollar you donate helps him: **→** Hire additional staff to knock on doors (if only for a few hours). → Get on TV and radio and tell his story (WITHOUT the fake news media spin). → Send out campaign mail, brochures, yard signs, T-shirts (you name it)! **** **All of these things are CRITICAL for running a successful ground campaign – and[ __Derrick is relying on conservatives like YOU to help fund it__](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zr0fb3962ni16st2ncurdehl5qitho5po47m937g_rp22sh2s8i6eob6ctgeap36chh2bs) ________________.** _**Will you help my husband win his Senate campaign by rushing over $25 or more?**_

---
You see, many people __**THINK**__ they know Derrick’s story based on the headlines and newspapers. _“January 6th Insurrectionist.”_ _“Redneck from West Virginia.”_ The media is going to say what it wants. But I know the real Derrick, and _I want you to know him too_. Derrick was my college sweetheart. ---
When we got married, we lived a normal American life. We had kids running around. Derrick was working on homes, helping out at the family ranch, even volunteering at rehab facilities across West Virginia – __a state ripped apart by opioids and alcoholism__. On top of running for local office, he also helped coached D1 football. Beyond the wins and losses, he wanted to teach young men how to __be good fathers, American__ ____patriots, and strong leaders__. But that all changed in a blink of an eye. **The life Derrick created for our family was** **FLIPPED UPSIDE DOWN OVERNIGHT.** **A SWAT team of Biden's FBI agents****busted down our front door. ** The kids were screaming. Derrick had his hands up. **I was CONFUSED, living in a NIGHTMARE.** Then I remembered – _Derrick went to Washington DC on January 6th to PEACEFULLY contest a stolen election_. _That’s what this was all about_. The Biden Regime labeled him an “insurrectionist” and that was it. **My husband was going to prison.** We tried to fight back. We argued entrapment. We argued violation of free speech. Nothing worked. The courts REFUSED to hear it. **Derrick’s fate was SEALED. ** He would be spending his nights in a cold, dark prison cell. I would be laying in bed alone wondering how I'm going to take care of four kids by myself. Months later, when Derrick was released on good behavior, _the man I saw come home was different_. He always had an interest in politics, _but going to prison lit a fire inside of him I had never seen before_.
---
[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zso0tn7daedd4naii2tsgnh0fdft0hut74ln2p7o_rp22sh2s8i6eob6ctge6p74c3h2bs)
---
So when Derrick found out he was PARDONED by President Trump, and was now eligible to run for U.S. Senate, _that’s immediately what he decided to do_. **I support him 100%. ** _Do you?_
---
[**DONATE TO MY HUSBAND'S CAMPAIGN**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z837v5pa2hh0oljf0g5bjn47homf1prgeca8cvu0_rp22sh2s8i6eob6ctge6p74c3h2bs)
---
This isn’t about “revenge” for Derrick. This is about justice. Justice for the **HUNDREDS** of Americans who were entrapped and imprisoned on Jan 6th. Justice for young girls like Laken Riley who were **MURDERED** by Joe Biden’s illegal aliens. Justice for our police officers, first responders, and military heroes who were **FIRED** over vaccine mandates. Justice for our coal miners and blue collar workers – right here in states like West Virginia – who’ve seen their livelihoods **SHIPPED** overseas. Now, I don’t know a whole lot about politics, but I know this: **Derrick’s running for Senate to look out for America's future – to look out for the people who have been IGNORED by the politicians for too long. ****He calls it the “Swamp”. ** Bottom line: _he needs your help to WIN_.

body:
Dear USO Supporter,
Gold Star Spouses deserve the utmost care, respect and support that we can provide. We saw you haven't signed the card yet in honor of Gold Star Spouses Day and wanted to reach out again.
Tomorrow is Gold Star Spouses Day, honoring spouses of military members who have made the ultimate sacrifice for our country. Please see our email below for more on this day's history.
**With the help of caring friends like you, the USO provides Gold Star Spouses with comfort and support during the most heartbreaking moments of their lives.**
There is one day left. **[Will you sign the USO's card to honor our fallen heroes, Gold Star Spouses and all who serve?](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/xdbZhG-9dxCY/SzFySWlCbzhlRXdvZU5naXVIY1dWNGcwaVhKWnY3cmo1QSswWm1iKzE5ZVAxRWVNdmZWK1p6WFdxZExadUtsM1VPOWFnSEJ3Ym1TT2kwTk9QWDBhcDZXSmd3WTAzdExRbUxEL25VdklLZmM9S0/cXpoUkl4TEJxYkxERjNHN0J0cSs5RUtLZVl1elRrcCs1MmNObDZ2UXlXNDRHc1d0TFFDNCt4Rk9uM3BsRlFXUlZhWEZ2Qi9TVk9mUHFuOUh5MjlpRVdqZ3hQenBZQzRBS0)**
With gratitude,
--The USO
* * *
**From: **gold-star@uso.org
**Sent: **Thursday, April 3, 2025
**Subject:** Remember. Respect. Honor.
[](https://www.uso.org)
[SIGN THE CARD](https://links.e.uso.)
---
A difficult day is almost here. On April 5, we come together to recognize Gold Star Spouses Day -- a day to honor the spouses of military members who have made the ultimate sacrifice for our country.
When families receive that dreaded call, their lives are forever changed. Through your compassion and generosity, the USO can continue programs such as the Families of the Fallen program, which has supported every dignified transfer of lives lost at Dover Air Force Base for the past 33 years. We help arrange travel and lodging for families to stay at Dover and witness the return of their loved one, providing around-the-clock support every step of the way.
**Today we 're asking all of our supporters to show their compassion and care for the thousands of Gold Star Spouses across the country right now. In March the Netanyahu regime shattered the ceasefire it agreed to [and killed at least 400 Palestinians](https://substack.com/redirect/f7f8def1-6582-45fc-bbe5-38acd5dfbd13?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). This week, Netanyahu again broke the ceasefire, bombing Gaza and [killing at least 112 more Palestinian civilians](https://substack.com/redirect/762c4e5c-818b-4ad9-a0d6-8f6c7cf5043e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the majority of them women and children. In response, the United States Senate yesterday [voted 85-15 to send Netanyahu more bombs](https://substack.com/redirect/47807c06-77b7-485d-a4f7-1426230e537e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Let's not mince words. This is genocide. And the U.S. Senate--by an overwhelming bipartisan vote--just signed off on it. Again. **Let 's Address This.**
**I am doing everything in my power to raise awareness on human rights and justice. I cannot do it alone. I hope you consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.**

## Hypocrisy Kills Democracy
Ask yourself: How can we possibly hope to stop fascism at home, if we are arming fascists abroad? Senator Sanders [explained](https://substack.com/redirect/3ac3f0b2-c8be-4d61-bf2b-fc2ee689508f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) what was at stake:
> _The sales would provide almost $8.8 billion more in heavy bombs and other munitions to Netanyahu, including more than 35,000 massive 2,000-pound bombs._
> _The first resolution, S.J.Res 33, would block a sale of $2.04 billion for 35,329 MK 84 2,000 lb. bombs and 4,000 I-2000 Penetrator warheads._
> _The second resolution, S.J.Res.26, would block $6.75 billion for 2,800 500-pound bombs, 2,166 Small Diameter Bombs, and tens of thousands of JDAM guidance kits._
In addition to a unanimous yes vote from MAGA Republicans, some 32 Democratic Senators voted yes to continue funding this mass atrocity. They are as follows:
> Duckworth, King, Alsobrooks, Peters, Slotkin, Klobuchar, Masto, Warner, Murray, Cantwell, Baldwin, Rosen, Shaheen, Hassan, Booker, Schumer, Gillibrand, Wyden, Fetterman, Reed, Whitehouse, Kelly, Gallego, Padilla, Schiff, Bennet, Hickenlooper, Blumenthal, Coons, Rochester, Ossoff, and Warnock.
So while the Democratic Party tweets about saving democracy, and speaks from the podium for 25 hours and 5 minutes about the importance of human life and dignity for all, it simultaneously proudly votes to fund one of the gravest human rights catastrophes of our time. And remember, at least [77% of Democratic voters want Democrats to ](https://substack.com/redirect/1cb2b45c-bb92-4ebe-a6c8-59b747bf0939?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[stop](https://substack.com/redirect/1cb2b45c-bb92-4ebe-a6c8-59b747bf0939?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[ arming Netanyahu](https://substack.com/redirect/1cb2b45c-bb92-4ebe-a6c8-59b747bf0939?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). How does party leadership expect to rally their base and win elections when they spit in the face of nearly 8 in 10 voters?
## Schumer Continues to Fail to Meet the Moment
And where was Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer? Proudly voting to continue arming Netanyahu. For those who may have missed it, Schumer is on record that he defines his job as to "[keep the left pro-Israel](https://substack.com/redirect/775c6e32-106f-4c99-88d1-5e7128388260?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." I could have swore his job was to uphold the United States Constitution, but as a lowly human rights lawyer what do I know? Though, perhaps Schumer's derangement is unsurprising given the grotesque anti-Muslim and anti-Arab bigotry he embraces, [shamelessly declaring](https://substack.com/redirect/fd621e0d-3f8d-42f2-9f57-f5f781163889?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> The fact of the matter is that too many Palestinians and too many Arabs do not want any Jewish state in the Middle East. Of course, we say it's our land, the Torah says it, but they don't believe in the Torah. So that's the reason there is not peace.
First, Schumer's ignorance aside, Muslims do believe in the Torah, and far from this being a religious conflict, [Muslims and Jews have lived in harmony for centuries](https://substack.com/redirect/a04972ef-a1b5-4cd2-a7dc-bc8e1a2c37c2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). But moreover, I would expect this hate from a right wing evangelical who doesn't believe in the separation of religion and state--but from the Democratic Senate Leader?
This is the type of hypocrisy that threatens to destroy us.
You cannot claim to defend democracy while you champion theocracy.
You cannot demand government ethics while bankrolling ethnic cleansing.
And you certainly cannot speak of human rights while you send weapons to a government committing war crimes. The receipts on these facts are devastating:
* According to a report by _The Lancet_ from way back in July, 2024, [more than 186,000 Palestinians had been killed in this Netanyahu enacted genocide](https://substack.com/redirect/6b696233-8c8c-4c04-97c5-6da56cab7bb9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--many burned alive, starved, or buried under rubble.
* In March, the UN published a detailed report accusing the Israeli military of committing [genocidal acts and mass rape](https://substack.com/redirect/77ab80bb-f89b-409c-85e6-16b60d88e4d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), including extrajudicial executions, and bombing hospitals, schools, and medics.
* Just last week, a UN investigation confirmed [the IDF killed 15 Palestinian medics and buried them in a mass grave](https://substack.com/redirect/cdf12dbe-1903-4d23-a46d-226f7207379c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--still trapped inside their ambulances.

These are war crimes. And the United States is funding them.
Where is the outrage?
Where is the accountability?
Where is the leadership?
And if this is the first you've heard about this, ask yourself why this wasn't front page news across every media outlet, as it rightly would have been if roles were reversed?
**If you find value in these critical updates that corporate media ignores, join our movement for justice and subscribe.**

## 15 Votes For Justice
But not everyone gave in. Below are the 15 Democratic and Independent Senators who voted NO on Trump's arms deal to Netanyahu. The Senators who instead chose to fight for humanity, international law, and justice are as follows:
* Chris Murphy (CT)
* Mazie Hirono (HI)
* Brian Schatz (HI)
* Dick Durbin (IL)
* Ed Markey (MA)
* Elizabeth Warren (MA)
* Chris Van Hollen (MD)
* Tina Smith (MN)
* Andy Kim (NJ)
* Martin Heinrich (NM)
* Ben Ray Lujan (NM)
* Jeff Merkley (OR)
* Tim Kaine (VA)
* Bernie Sanders (VT)
* Peter Welch (VT)

We thank them. And we also acknowledge that this is the _bare minimum_. We need them to continue to expand this coalition and not relent in the fight for justice until we can force Netanyahu to relent in bombing civilians and honor the ceasefire.
Because for the other 85 Senators who voted to fund war crimes and mass murder--do you realize that you are complicit? That you are failing the test of history, of morality, and of basic decency? Your vote for more war--especially in breach of the ceasefire you agreed to--betrays both the Palestinian people and the American people who entrusted you with the responsibility to uphold justice.
This is how democracies fall. Not overnight. But vote by vote, bomb by bomb, betrayal by betrayal.
## Conclusion
Here's the bottom line: The path to liberation starts with accountability.
* [Call your Senators](https://substack.com/redirect/771afc7a-143f-4adb-8050-306b203cce35?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Demand they reverse course and stop funding genocide.
* Show up to town halls. Write letters. Share this truth. Raise your voice everywhere.
* In November--remember who chose bombs over babies, genocide over justice.

Because while we are not helpless--we must be honest: we ~~are running~~ have run out of time. History will ask what we did in this moment? Let it be known--we raised our voices. We stood on the side of life. And we refused to be silent in the face of state-sanctioned slaughter.

subject: Teichert in the Trenches - April 2025
body:
A monthly newsletter highlighting a snippet...
---
| | | | | |
---
| |
#### Teichert in the Trenches - April 2025
Welcome to this month’s installment of Teichert in the Trenches, a monthly newsletter highlighting a snippet of my attempts to maximize my impact on people and our great nation and to develop the leaders our nation needs! ** _Teichert in the News_**
---
| | | | [ ](https://eufi5.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeFuBmP64SPACXkt7Xr7g/tFx5cIZ-Mn0t)
---
I was on the road a big portion of the month, and mostly only available for radio interviews. Please enjoy this one on the economic conditions in Maryland from WBAL that is a follow-on to my Baltimore Sun commentary (linked below) (March 11th)
| | | | [ ](https://eufi5.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeG13EXv1dZJgdaBrW9hw/i4usClfe6E6E)
---
| | | Of course, when asked to do several interviews about America’s next-generation fighter aircraft – the F-47 – I found a way to fit them into my schedule! Can you tell I enjoy talking about this topic from the link above? (March 21st) ** _Thoughts by Teichert_**
---
| | | | [ Maryland's Dire Economic Outlook Can't Be Downplayed](https://eufi5.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeG7uggjyojTAjPUbUSIC/1BPqPaqUcSpg "US absence in the world is as dangerous as US weakness")
---
| | | Thanks to the _Baltimore Sun_ for publishing my commentary that laments the current condition of Maryland’s economy. It is characterized by strangulation, Californication, and dereliction.
---
| | | | [ The World Is Better Off Because Israel Has Stood Strong](https://eufi5.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGEm8pYvztcepEnLSksS/LKskvTtQ8JDK "Prayers for a Nation")
---
| | | I appreciate _Real Clear Defense_ for publishing my thoughts on the strategies of President Biden vs. President Trump related to the release of Israeli hostages in Gaza. ** _Teichert in the Trenches_**
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | |
---
| | |
---
| | | |
---
| | | **_Behind the Scenes_**
---
| | | |
---
| |
---
| | | Here are some of the early sketches of the main character of my kid’s book (thanks Arlinda “Pico” Miller). I’ll be crowd sourcing the title on social media during the next month, and I welcome your inputs! (I titled my previous two books from inputs provided on social media, and they ended up way better than anything I would have thought of myself). The main character’s name is John the dragon (no relation).
---
|
---
Since I do most of the TV interviews from my amazing setup at home, I don’t make it into the studio much. It was fun to join Blake Burman and former FAA Administrator Billy Nolen in studio on NewsNation with an amazing real backdrop of the U.S. Capitol. Maybe I’ll start going in more often. ** _My Bookshelf_**
| | | |
---
“Winston Churchill was not an overtly religious man, but he was a man of faith. He believed in God’s ultimate providential care – for himself and for his nation. Such a faith was foundational to his internal fortitude when all external signs pointed to disaster.”
| | | |
---
“Regardless of Truman’s legacy, the first four months of his administration should rank as the most challenging and action-packed of any four-month period in any American presidency. Through declassified war documents, personal diaries, international communications of the highest diplomacy, and other primary sources, the figures who appear in this book will tell you that themselves. Arguably, no other four-month period has had so much import in shaping the world we live in today.”
|
---
I read this as a leadership book. If you turn “acquiring clients” into “recruiting team members” and “retaining clients” as “retaining team members,” the concepts in this book are the same – providing 100 powerful and useful tools for leaders at all levels. ** _PLUS Posts for the Month_**
| | | |
---
| [ Band of Brothers - Guest Post (March 1st)](https://eufi5.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGLdayNtB3m8v465R3Si/nTbxeQmgkqf_ "Pronouns Matter")
---
| [ A Monument of Immobility
(March 15th)](https://eufi5.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGSV37CqMDvd0tOpPM2y/7kppDjUlhriY "Finding the Stars")
---
| [ Standards!
(March 22nd)](https://eufi5.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGZMVG1nXO576ihZNedE/ZJfjQ5AfLnVV "We Must Listen")
---
| [ Responding Right as God Works All Things Together for Good
(March 29th)](https://eufi5.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGgDxOqkiYEbCY0JLxDU/zZMJx1JGEQOO "Transforming Common Days into Thanksgiving")
---
| | | **_Blasts from the Past_**
---
| | | | [ ](https://eufi5.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGn5PXfhtiO5INJ3KFnk/9qpadHnKSpDD)
---
Life is not a solo sport; neither is leadership or innovation. Please see these thoughts that I published last year in “From The Green Notebook” about shared humanity and mutual benefit (it is an excerpt from BOOM!)
| [ ](https://eufi5.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGtwrgUf4sXZOCbnIYO0/9OtYFS38Zwua)
---
| | | This is my first TV interview (from March 28th, 2023 – two years ago), and Greta Van Susteren is a tough starting point! I had no idea on the topic to be discussed other than a focus on national security. ** _Dad Joke of the Month_**

|
---
I love this concept for a new Air & Space Museum!

name: Chris Pappas
subject: I'm running for Senate
disclaimer_text: Paid for by State Democrats Committee (StateDemocrats
body:
I’ll always put New Hampshire first.
#
Peter, I’m Congressman Chris Pappas, and State Democrats Committee said I could reach out with some big news:
**I’m officially running to be New Hampshire’s next U.S. Senator.** I’m going to share more about why I’m in this race, but if you’re already on board, **[split a contribution to my campaign and State Democrats Committee today.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/87675?refcode=em20250404-8866&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=8866%2E614464%2EJHktCE)**
I’m running for Senate because at this pivotal moment, our economy, our democracy, and our way of life are on the line. New Hampshire deserves a Senator who is grounded in the people, places, and values of this state – and one who is ready to lead on day one.
Our country is at a crossroads, and the decisions we make now will have generational impacts. You can count on me to continue taking on big fights and to confront the Trump Administration, self-dealing billionaires, and extreme politicians who are threatening our future and our ability to get things done for New Hampshire.
**[Peter, can I count on you to become a Founding Donor to my campaign with a $10 contribution, split between my campaign and State Democrats Committee right now? We can’t win this race without major grassroots support.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/87675?refcode=em20250404-8866&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=8866%2E614464%2EJHktCE)**
**These fights are deeply personal to me.** My family immigrated from Greece and opened a restaurant in Manchester 108 years ago, a small business that remains at the heart of the community today. Running that small business showed me the power of hard work and serving others, but the opportunity that my ancestors and so many others like them sought has never been further away – and the Trump Administration is too busy cutting deals for their billionaire buddies to give a damn.
I’m also openly gay and happily married to my husband, Vann. With the current wave of hateful policies leveled at the LGBTQ+ community, I know how important representation is at this moment. **If elected, I’d be the first openly gay male U.S. Senator in history** – a badge of honor I’d wear proudly as I advocate for full equality.
I am the proud product of public education, and I come from a family of business owners _(my grandfather invented the chicken tender at the restaurant – seriously!)._ I understand firsthand the need to support neighborhood schools and small businesses in our community. **These are the lifeblood of our economy and the pillars of opportunity for everyone.**
My life experiences are what led me to successfully run for four terms in Congress and win in one of the “swingiest” districts in the nation. Before I won my election in 2018, no one had managed to hold the seat for more than one term for more than a decade. I’m no stranger to tough electoral fights. **Now I’m ready to take on the fight to keep New Hampshire’s Senate seat blue.**
We can’t afford to sit on the sidelines of the big fights ahead – not with so much at stake, from the rising costs debilitating working families to the threats to the future of our democracy. We’ve taken on big fights together in Congress. Now it’s time to win this critical Senate seat so we can keep standing up to the Trump Administration and the self-dealing billionaires threatening our future. Can I count on you to join the fight?
**[Peter, if you’re with me, let’s make a powerful statement together and prove that we’re ready to win this race. Become a Founding Donor with a $10 donation to my campaign and State Democrats Committee now.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/87675?refcode=em20250404-8866&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=8866%2E614464%2EJHktCE)**
Thank you again to State Democrats Committee for letting me reach out today.
With gratitude,
Chris
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/87675?refcode=em20250404-8866&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=8866%2E614464%2EJHktCE)

subject: Tim Walz is DESCENDING on Ohio
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VIVEK RAMASWAMY FOR OHIO
body:
He flies in on Monday. Before he gets here...

He flies in on Monday. Before he gets here...
He flies in on Monday. Before he gets here...
| |
---
| | | | [](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews._NBfyEkWkw)
---
I don't have much time, so I'll get right to it:

Kamala's radical running mate - Tim Walz - is coming to Ohio in a matter of hours. He's activating liberals in key battleground states Republicans need to win.
---
| [](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.)
---
[He descends on Ohio on Monday and Tuesday.](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews. "He descends on Ohio on Monday and Tuesday. ")

We're building a movement here in Ohio that is incompatible with his far-Left, big-government radicalism.

That's why I want to welcome him to the Buckeye State by shattering my all-time fundraising record. **[I'm asking EVERYONE who rejected Harris and Walz at the ballot box to join our movement before he flies in.](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews. "I’m asking EVERYONE who rejected Harris and Walz at the ballot box to join our movement before he flies in. ")**
---
| | [**BEFORE MONDAY: STOP TIM WALZ** ](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.)
---
Walz is a real piece of work.

Kamala Harris added him to the ticket ONLY because he called Ohio's own, JD Vance, "weird" on national TV and because he's a Midwesterner, hoping he'd appeal to Rust Belt voters.

What a joke. Our excellent Vice President is about as normal as they come, and voters here flocked to President Trump in record numbers.

**This is Tim Walz 's big comeback tour. [We can make it completely backfire if everyone reading this joins our campaign before Monday.](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews. "We can make it completely backfire if everyone reading this joins our campaign before Monday.")**
---
| | [**BEFORE MONDAY: STOP TIM WALZ** ](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.-LGB1cx316OwSVZzzrrWw)
---
I want to make myself perfectly clear:

My campaign for Governor is antithetical to Tim Walz's vision for the country. He wants to tax you more, wreck our businesses, continue our broken education system, open our borders, and lay the groundwork for a complete Liberal takeover of America.

_We can - and will - destroy Walz's radical ideology root and branch with this campaign. _

**[But I can't do this without you. I'm personally asking you to join us today.](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.-g "We can make it completely backfire if everyone reading this joins our campaign before Monday.")**

God bless you,
Vivek Ramaswamy
---

Columbus, OH 43201

If you do not want to receive emails from From the Desk of Honorable Patrick J. Murphy, you can unsubscribe [here](https://substack..3zGQJpcVV_prsqnwSE05nFQ3Z3idfSb7GGs71BYC09Q?).
On Wednesday, Donald Trump declared a national emergency with "Liberation Day" and announced sweeping new tariffs on nearly every U.S. trading partner. The President called it a "declaration of economic independence." Last year, the US imported $1.2 trillion more than it exported - yesterday's announcement triggered a $2.5 trillion loss in the stock market, which the majority of American pension plans are tied to.
Beneath the slogans lies one of the most aggressively misguided trade measures in over a century. Here's what happened, what it means for your wallet, how it will affect us here in Pennsylvania, and why many experts say this will backfire.
### **At a Glance:**
* **New tariffs:** At least **10% on all imports** --higher for 60+ countries with large U.S. trade deficits
* **Auto imports:** A flat **25% tariff** , regardless of origin
* **Trump 's claim:** These tariffs will attract investment, revive manufacturing, and lower prices
* **Experts say:** they're more likely to raise prices, reduce product choice, and spark global retaliation

* **Pennsylvania exported $14.2 billion to Canada in 2024, imported $13 billion** to Canada, experts say it will cost PA businesses **$5.3 billion**

Tyler Cowen, writing in _[The Free Press](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/60f773b0-f91b-4a0f-8554-4536a8411c91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_ , called it "perhaps the worst economic own goal I have seen in my lifetime."
**How are Trump 's new tariffs calculated?
**They're based on a rough formula: the U.S. trade deficit with a country divided by how much the U.S. imports from that country. For example:
> $73.93B (deficit with Taiwan) ÷ $116.26B (imports from Taiwan) = 63.6%
> Under Trump's plan, the U.S. would then impose a "reciprocal tariff" at roughly half that rate--about 31.8% on goods imported from Taiwan.
This rate is almost as high as China's despite Taiwan being a democratic ally and strategic partner.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/51a954c2-e2ae-4b38-bf62-90ba67c61143?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Trump's Tariff Chart
These numbers include vague factors like ["currency manipulation"](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/3715d615-298f-47a8-a9e2-2f8df3b958f4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and non-tariff barriers, and don't reflect actual tariffs charged by those countries. For instance, China's real average tariff on U.S. goods is closer to 23%, according to the [Peterson Institute for International Economics.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/9ad3f6e1-9f5f-4cc4-a1d0-fdcb1ccf4e4b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Even the **Office of the U.S. Trade Representative** admits the goal is to "balance bilateral trade deficits"--not necessarily to reflect real-world tariff rates.
### **📉 Pension Plans are Tied to Markets & They Are Panicking**
The day after the announcement, markets tanked:
* **Dow Jones** : Dropped 1,500 points
* **S &P 500**: Fell 4.8%, the [worst single day drop since the March 2020 COVID crash](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b86bce83-aae0-4bf4-aa72-b3cb3d1d9cb6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (S&P dropped 4.9% on 9/11)
* The Canadian dollar slid sharply, as investors worried about retaliatio

| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/209677e9-a7a7-48a7-8650-0faffb5fe894?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
### **Retaliation Is Already Underway**
* **🇨 🇦 Canada:** 25% counter-tariff on U.S. autos that don't comply with USMCA
* **🇪 🇺 EU:** Preparing its own response
* **🇨 🇳 China:** May restrict U.S. agricultural imports (Pennsylvania exports $3.5 billion in goods to China in 2024, including $2.6 billion in agriculture)

| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b042d8bb-7c26-42e6-ac98-80598cd93cd0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
### **What It Could Cost You**
The [nonpartisan Tax Foundation](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/339982e6-257d-4ab2-ac29-a4f05fc5f548?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) estimates the**average American household will pay $2,100 more per year for goods** because of the new tariffs. Others say it will cost $3,800 per household, depressing consumer confidence even more**

**Tariffs essentially function as taxes --paid by _importers_ , not foreign governments. This makes the increased costs trickle down to the consumer.
### **History 's Warning**
The **Smoot-Hawley Tariff Act of 1930** also began with good intentions. It was supposed to protect American farmers. Instead, it sparked a global trade war that deepened the Great Depression.
At the time,[ over 1,000 economists warned President Hoover](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/980c09fb-e201-46c2-b570-0c72eb3895f5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) not to sign it--but political pressure won out**.** It's a reminder that when expert advice is ignored, history doesn't always repeat, but it often rhymes.
And this isn't Trump's first attempt:
* From 2018-2020, his tariffs cost U.S. companies over **$80 billion**
* Studies show nearly **100% of those costs** were passed on to U.S. consumers (Tax Foundation, Peterson Institute)
* They helped steel but hurt agriculture and tech (PA #19 in US Ag)

### **📊 Economic Snapshot (April 2025)**
* **Inflation:** 3.2% (Fed target is 2%)
* **Unemployment:** 4.0% (up slightly from 3.7%)
* **GDP growth:** ~2.1% (Q1 est.)
* **Consumer confidence:** Down to a 12 year low ([Conference Board](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/41787816-00d8-43d3-b8df-4360a1ce05bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) (70% of our economy tied to consumer spending)

In other words, after the Covid crisis, inflation relatively tamed and no recession came, though, things aren't moving in the right direction.
Economists interviewed by **[CNN](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/ccda3df7-5c69-4226-bda7-2b33928d83cb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** warned that this move could push the global economy into recession, especially if retaliation spirals.
Economic stability comes from predictability. With these new tariffs we went from uncertainty to pessimism
If Congress doesn't find their backbone and step in, we might look back on this week as the moment America chose to preemptively isolate ourselves from the global markets.
\- Patrick

At a Glance: New tariffs: At least 10% on all imports --higher for 60+ countries with large U.S. trade deficits Auto imports: A flat 25% tariff , regardless of origin Trump 's claim: These tariffs will attract investment, revive manufacturing, and lower prices Experts say: they're more likely to raise prices, reduce product choice, and spark global retaliation Pennsylvania exported $14.2 billion to Canada in 2024, imported $13 billion to Canada, experts say it will cost PA businesses $5.3 billion Tyler Cowen, writing in , called it "perhaps the worst economic own goal I have seen in my lifetime." How are Trump 's new tariffs calculated? They're based on a rough formula: the U.S. trade deficit with a country divided by how much the U.S. imports from that country. For example: $73.93B (deficit with Taiwan) ÷ $116.26B (imports from Taiwan) = 63.6% Under Trump's plan, the U.S. would then impose a "reciprocal tariff" at roughly half that rate--about 31.8% on goods imported from Taiwan. This rate is almost as high as China's despite Taiwan being a democratic ally and strategic partner. | | ---|---|--- Trump's Tariff Chart These numbers include vague factors like and non-tariff barriers, and don't reflect actual tariffs charged by those countries. For instance, China's real average tariff on U.S. goods is closer to 23%, according to the Even the Office of the U.S. Trade Representative admits the goal is to "balance bilateral trade deficits"--not necessarily to reflect real-world tariff rates. 📉 Pension Plans are Tied to Markets & They Are Panicking The day after the announcement, markets tanked: Dow Jones : Dropped 1,500 points S &P 500: Fell 4.8%, the (S&P dropped 4.9% on 9/11) The Canadian dollar slid sharply, as investors worried about retaliatio | | ---|---|--- Retaliation Is Already Underway 🇨 🇦 Canada: 25% counter-tariff on U.S. autos that don't comply with USMCA 🇪 🇺 EU: Preparing its own response 🇨 🇳 China: May restrict U.S. agricultural imports (Pennsylvania exports $3.5 billion in goods to China in 2024, including $2.6 billion in agriculture) | | ---|---|--- What It Could Cost You The estimates theaverage American household will pay $2,100 more per year for goods because of the new tariffs. Others say it will cost $3,800 per household, depressing consumer confidence even more Tariffs essentially function as taxes --paid by importers , not foreign governments. This makes the increased costs trickle down to the consumer. History 's Warning The Smoot-Hawley Tariff Act of 1930 also began with good intentions. It was supposed to protect American farmers. Instead, it sparked a global trade war that deepened the Great Depression. At the time, not to sign it--but political pressure won out. It's a reminder that when expert advice is ignored, history doesn't always repeat, but it often rhymes. And this isn't Trump's first attempt: From 2018-2020, his tariffs cost U.S. companies over $80 billion Studies show nearly 100% of those costs were passed on to U.S. consumers (Tax Foundation, Peterson Institute) They helped steel but hurt agriculture and tech (PA #19 in US Ag) 📊 Economic Snapshot (April 2025) Inflation: 3.2% (Fed target is 2%) Unemployment: 4.0% (up slightly from 3.7%) GDP growth: ~2.1% (Q1 est.) Consumer confidence: Down to a 12 year low () (70% of our economy tied to consumer spending) In other words, after the Covid crisis, inflation relatively tamed and no recession came, though, things aren't moving in the right direction. Economists interviewed by warned that this move could push the global economy into recession, especially if retaliation spirals. Economic stability comes from predictability. With these new tariffs we went from uncertainty to pessimism If Congress doesn't find their backbone and step in, we might look back on this week as the moment America chose to preemptively isolate ourselves from the global markets. \- Patrick The Honorable Patrick J. Murphy is a Wharton lecturer, Vetrepreneur, and was the 32nd Army Under Secretary after earning the Bronze Star for service in Baghdad, Iraq as an All-American with the 82nd Airborne Division --@PatrickMurphyPA on Instagram and Twitter. | | Hi Friend, Welcome to the latest New Pennsylvania Project newsletter!New Pennsylvania Project celebrates the ruling by U.S. District Judge Susan Paradise Baxter, which holds that the practice of rejected undated mail-in ballots in Pennsylvania violates the First and Fourteenth Amendments. The RNC has already filed a Notice of Appeal on Wednesday afternoon. Disqualifying voters’ ballots over a trivial paperwork errors on their return envelope discourages voters from participating in the democratic process.We want Pennsylvanians voting twice a year - every year - and not disenfranchised by unnecessary rules. We hope this decision motivates voters to turn out to make their voices heard. This November, voters will have the power to retain or vacate three seats of the Pennsylvania Supreme Court.The votes cast by powerful Pennsylvania voters in November will impact our lives for years to come, as Pennsylvania’s Supreme Court will make decisions about our election administration, access to abortion, the safety of our workplaces, and the right to unionize. "Pennsylvania was one of the most litigious states in the entire country as it related to the 2020 election results and election administration,” said Kadida Kenner, CEO of the New Pennsylvania Project and co-chair of Why Courts Matter – Pennsylvania. “And it was our circuit courts, and our federal district courts in Pennsylvania that were making judgments about our provisional ballots, whether they should count or not and the legitimacy of our elections.” In Pennsylvania, voters have the opportunity to help ensure that our state courts remain independent and fair. Make sure you make your voice heard at the polls.

body:
If you're curious about what to make about Donald Trump's actions, you can watch my conversation here.

Yesterday I talked to Ben Meiselas of the MeidasTouch about the impact of Trump's tariffs on California and the rest of the country.
If you're curious about what to make about Donald Trump's actions, **[you can watch my conversation here.](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/4148?t=1&akid=2320%2E4767699%2EZHzy3c)**
[](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/4148?t=2&akid=2320%2E4767699%2EZHzy3c)
**As Governor of California, I want you to know that we will not stand idly by.**
First, California is the tentpole of the U.S. economy. Fourteen percent of the GDP of the United States comes from California. We are the largest manufacturing state. The next largest state is Texas, and we're 41% bigger than Texas.
We have more jobs in forestry, agriculture, and fishing. In so many ways, California is a microcosm of the United States and we feel these impacts in a very profound way.
**That is why I have directed my administration to look at new opportunities to expand trade and remind our trading partners around the globe that California remains a stable partner.**
**[You can see more about that here:](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/4149?t=3&akid=2320%2E4767699%2EZHzy3c)**
[](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/4149?t=4&akid=2320%2E4767699%2EZHzy3c)
The trade war that Donald Trump has launched is going to be felt in pretty profound ways to real people, including those who voted for Donald Trump and are now being betrayed by this very administration.
Thank you for reading, and for watching.

subject: Republicans are afraid of you using your voice
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jeff Merkley for Oregon
body:
Recently, Trump signed an executive order to decimate Vote by Mail across the country and severely limit your access to the ballot box.
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/105174674/537592842/150430950?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTMyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMzEyYjdkNS02YjExLWYwMTEtOGIzZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5AOBFTjExiuZvXeC7i9dzSftqoBXl6TdRN9u9boQXt4=&emci=63bd2e9d-6a11-f011-8b3d-0022482a9fb7&emdi=d312b7d5-6b11-f011-8b3d-0022482a9fb7&ceid=7731215)
---

| | Recently, Trump signed an executive order to decimate Vote by Mail across the country and severely limit your access to the ballot box. **Oregonians have been voting by mail for over 20 years, and it's why we consistently have some of the highest rates of voter participation in the country.** It's safe, secure, and leaves a paper trail—and there's no waiting in long lines or bad weather to cast a ballot. **Republicans are afraid of you using your voice.** They're afraid to be held accountable for their unpopular agenda. The reason Trump and Republicans want to limit vote by mail is so that they can force people to vote only on election day, where they can manipulate turnout by moving polling locations, putting out disinformation about polling locations, and closing locations. The strength of our democracy depends on Americans' ability to make their voices heard. That's why I've championed legislation to help expand Vote by Mail, early voting, and other reforms to make voting easier and more secure. In 2025, MAGA Republicans across the United States are rolling back common-sense voting laws and implementing new restrictions because they know they can't win on their ideas. They're trying to rig the rules to cling to power. **The ballot box is the beating heart of our democracy, and we need to be doing everything we can to protect and expand access to it.** We're standing by the right to vote for all Americans against tactics used by Republicans to keep people from voting, particularly members of specific groups like folks who live in cities, underserved communities, students, and reservations. I know you're with me in this fight because we know Vote by Mail is a democracy issue, not a political issue. I know you're with me in this fight because we know Vote by Mail is a democracy issue, not a political issue. name: Sara Jacobs
subject: 3 things
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Friends,
When I’m back home in San Diego, I get the same questions a lot. What are Democrats doing to push back against Trump? What can I do as an individual to push back? Is there any good news on the horizon?
I’m going to try to answer those questions for you every week. So, here are 3 of each!
3 things I did this week to push back against Donald Trump, Elon Musk, and House Republicans:
1. I introduced the Delete DOGE Act to defund DOGE and stop Elon Musk from stealing from the American people to line his own pockets. DOGE has slashed essential government services and fired tens of thousands of federal workers who perform vitally important jobs to keep Americans safe every day. It’s time for that to stop.

2. Congressman Juan Vargas and I hosted a “Know Your Rights” training for anyone concerned about interactions with federal law enforcement. After an ICE raid in El Cajon and so many horrifying stories about the Trump Administration’s disregard for due process, we were glad to be able to provide important information to our constituents about how to exercise their constitutional rights (which are granted to anyone in the U.S., regardless of their immigration status).

3. I questioned the Commander of NORTHCOM (the U.S. Northern Command) and NORAD (North American Aerospace Defense Command) during a House Armed Services Committee oversight hearing , affirming their commitment to uphold the law and ensure that no military personnel are involved in the arrest or detention of migrants.

(I know I said 3 things, but it was a busy week.)

4. Senator Tammy Duckworth and I introduced the IVF for Military Families Act , a bill that would require TRICARE to cover infertility diagnosis and treatment (including IVF). Members of Congress have access to health care plans that cover these important reproductive services, and it’s time we ensure the same is available for our service members and their families. Donald Trump says he’s the “father of fertility,” so we’re calling him out: support this bill or stop lying to the American people.

5. Congresswoman Anna Paulina Luna, Congresswoman Brittany Pettersen, and I took on Speaker Mike Johnson – and won. Reps. Luna, Pettersen, and I are working together on a bipartisan effort to allow Members of Congress who are new parents to proxy vote for the first 12 weeks after they give birth. Speaker Johnson tried to kill our effort with a shady procedural play (essentially tying the passage of key pieces of the Trump agenda to the failure of our effort), and he lost. Nine Republicans bucked their party leadership and voted with us. Speaker Johnson threw a fit and cancelled votes for the rest of the week, halting further progress on their dangerous agenda.
3 things you can do to fight back and make a difference in your community:
1. Attend the Hands Off! National Day of Action on Saturday (April 5) : People from across the country are coming together for a mass mobilization event to call out Trump and Musk’s illegal billionaire power grab. There will be a big march in Washington, D.C. and other rallies held in cities across the country. [https://handsoff2025.com] I’ll be marching in San Diego’s rally at noon (meet at Civic Center Plaza at 1200 Third Avenue) – I hope to see you there!

2. Call Republican Members of Congress to sign onto H.R. 2557, the IVF for Military Families Act : Republicans repeatedly said throughout the last election cycle that they supported IVF and fertility services for families who need it. Now, we’ve introduced a bill to secure those services for military families – but no Republicans have signed on. You can call the U.S. House switchboard at (202) 224-3121 to speak to Republican Members of Congress and demand that they join the bill.

3. Get trained on how to build pro-democracy power : Women’s March and Public Citizen are hosting an 8-week training series on how you can organize within your community against the threats from the Trump Administration. The first two trainings have already happened, but you can join for one or all six of the remaining sessions. [https://www.mobilize.us/risefordemocracy/event/763611]
3 pieces of good news:
1. Senator Cory Booker held the Senate floor for 25 hours and 5 minutes , halting the harmful work of the Republican majority for a full day and defeating the 68-year-old record of segregationist Senator Strom Thurmond. Senator Booker, who had to speak and remain standing for the duration of the 25 hours, passionately preached about his love for America and urged us all to get into “good trouble” as we stand against Trump’s agenda.

2. A U.S. appeals court denied the Trump Administration’s request to overturn a previous ruling blocking Trump’s ban on trans service members in the military (yes, that’s a quadruple negative) . After the ruling, the Navy sent out a notice that all voluntary and involuntary separations for trans service members are paused — a major victory and an important step in upholding the dignity and rights of the trans community and keeping trained and qualified folks in our military.

3. The Inspector General of the Department of Defense is opening an investigation into Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth after he used Signal, a commercial messaging platform, to share highly sensitive, classified information about imminent U.S. military strikes against Houthi targets in Yemen. Secretary Hegseth showed a reckless disregard for the safety of our service members involved in the strikes, and this investigation is a really important step in holding him accountable (and hopefully showing him the door).
I hope this was helpful (and even a little bit uplifting). Let me know if you enjoyed reading it — and if there’s anything else you’d like to hear about next week.
Warmly,
Sara

body:
I won’t sit by while they dismantle everything.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/105175758/537594854/1328794144?refcode=ea.d2bed1b2-6c11-f011-8b3d-0022482a9fb7&ms=ea.d2bed1b2-6c11-f011-8b3d-0022482a9fb7&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQyYmVkMWIyLTZjMTEtZjAxMS04YjNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=pEOm5SsxQhn5HjdvLuBzO2CtK_bDHx9e0E3cNnBdSFg=&emci=af228200-c110-f011-8b3d-0022482a9fb7&emdi=d2bed1b2-6c11-f011-8b3d-0022482a9fb7&ceid=4823105)
---
I know what it’s like to get the news. To sit in a doctor’s office, hear that awful “c-word” — cancer — and feel the ground shift beneath you. In 2022, I was diagnosed with non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma. I went through months of chemotherapy. But I was lucky. I had access to incredible doctors and effective treatments made possible by decades of medical research. I don’t take that for granted. Not for a second. This is why I can’t stay silent while Donald Trump and Elon Musk work to tear down the protections that keep people from getting sick in the first place. They’re attacking the very science that saved my life. This administration is trying to slash hundreds of millions of dollars in medical research funding at the National Institutes of Health. They’re letting conspiracy theorists like RFK Jr. dictate public health policy and even pressuring scientists to erase references to mRNA vaccine technology from their research grant applications. These are direct attacks on life-saving science. And while this administration guts medicine, they’re also allowing corporate polluters to poison the air we breathe and the water we drink. **Trump’s EPA unleashed the most consequential environmental rollback in decades** with plans to gut pollution limits on coal plants, clean car standards, and climate regulations. The EPA Administrator Lee Zeldin said his goal, in his own words, is to drive **_“a dagger through the heart of climate-change religion.”_** If they succeed, Big Oil and corporate polluters will get a free pass to pump even more toxins into our environment, and the price we pay is measured in asthma attacks, cancer diagnoses, and lives cut short. This is why I’m staying in the fight. I know you’re tired, and it feels like hope is in short supply. I’m fighting those feelings, too — but despair is not an option. Cancer made me think even more about the time I have left and how I want to use it. **I don’t want to look back with regrets. I want to know that I did everything in my power to fight for the future — for our health and for the generations that come after us. That’s what keeps me moving forward. That’s why I refuse to sit this one out.** We owe it to our children and their children to demand better. We owe it to ourselves to end fossil fuel dependence and prioritize public health. At JanePAC, we’re building the strongest possible defense — electing bold down-ballot leaders who believe in science and will fight like hell to protect our health and our planet. **[We’re building grassroots power in states around the country to stop Donald Trump and his allies from pushing this reckless, deadly agenda at the state and local levels. But we can’t do it without your help. clean_body: I won’t sit by while they dismantle everything. | I know what it’s like to get the news. To sit in a doctor’s office, hear that awful “c-word” — cancer — and feel the ground shift beneath you. In 2022, I was diagnosed with non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma. I went through months of chemotherapy. But I was lucky. I had access to incredible doctors and effective treatments made possible by decades of medical research. I don’t take that for granted. Not for a second. This is why I can’t stay silent while Donald Trump and Elon Musk work to tear down the protections that keep people from getting sick in the first place. They’re attacking the very science that saved my life. This administration is trying to slash hundreds of millions of dollars in medical research funding at the National Institutes of Health. They’re letting conspiracy theorists like RFK Jr. dictate public health policy and even pressuring scientists to erase references to mRNA vaccine technology from their research grant applications. These are direct attacks on life-saving science. And while this administration guts medicine, they’re also allowing corporate polluters to poison the air we breathe and the water we drink. Trump’s EPA unleashed the most consequential environmental rollback in decades with plans to gut pollution limits on coal plants, clean car standards, and climate regulations. The EPA Administrator Lee Zeldin said his goal, in his own words, is to drive “a dagger through the heart of climate-change religion.” If they succeed, Big Oil and corporate polluters will get a free pass to pump even more toxins into our environment, and the price we pay is measured in asthma attacks, cancer diagnoses, and lives cut short. This is why I’m staying in the fight. I know you’re tired, and it feels like hope is in short supply. I’m fighting those feelings, too — but despair is not an option. Cancer made me think even more about the time I have left and how I want to use it. I don’t want to look back with regrets. I want to know that I did everything in my power to fight for the future — for our health and for the generations that come after us. That’s what keeps me moving forward. That’s why I refuse to sit this one out. We owe it to our children and their children to demand better. We owe it to ourselves to end fossil fuel dependence and prioritize public health. At JanePAC, we’re building the strongest possible defense — electing bold down-ballot leaders who believe in science and will fight like hell to protect our health and our planet. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = With determination, Jane Fonda = P.S. Subject: We must prevent this power grab in Georgia
Friday’s the last day of the 2025 legislative session, and Georgia lawmakers are rushing to pass TWO last-minute voter suppression bills. [**We’re fighting back, but we’re counting on urgent support from grassroots activists like you in the final sprint — please make a donation right away to help protect the freedom to vote.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/105176991/537598921/-99196721?refcode=bsc_emm_ffa_20250404_f_GALegLiftnote_v1s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNzQ2M2EzYy02ZTExLWYwMTEtOGIzZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-F0ulo_4K7ysAJh9kAEfUVDphh27nWSeCS1lM3QSZGk=)
**The bills would make it harder to cast a ballot and easier for extreme activists to challenge Georgians’ right to vote. The provisions would:**
**1\. Ban Georgians from dropping off mail ballots over the weekend before Election Day** — targeting the exact moment when busy people likely have more time to return their ballots.
**2\. Allow cuts to Saturday early voting** — when many parents, students, caregivers, and folks who work long hours during the week have time to vote — for certain local elections.
**3\. Give unelected State Election Board (SEB) members more control over who stays on the voter rolls** — rewarding the SEB’s Trump-aligned majority for bending to conspiracy theorists, breaking public trust, and violating the law.
**4\. Enshrine policies that bipartisan elections experts have called out as harmful,** like mandated video surveillance of absentee ballot drop boxes and expanded partisan poll watcher access to sensitive areas in elections offices.
[**Chip in right now to fight back against policies like these that restrict voting rights and damage our elections.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/105176992/537598922/-99196721?refcode=bsc_emm_ffa_20250404_f_GALegLiftnote_v1s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNzQ2M2EzYy02ZTExLWYwMTEtOGIzZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-F0ulo_4K7ysAJh9kAEfUVDphh27nWSeCS1lM3QSZGk=)
Let’s be clear: the legislation fits into a broader pattern of voter suppression in Georgia. In the past few years, new laws have made mass voter purges easier, imposed burdensome voter ID requirements, criminalized handing out food and water to voters in line, and placed unnecessary limits on ballot drop boxes.
These new provisions, if they pass, would once again make it harder to cast a ballot, especially for voters of color, students, and frequent movers.
Everyone should have an equal opportunity to make their voices heard in our democracy. They should be able to vote at a time that fits their schedule. And they shouldn’t have to worry that some partisan activist they’ve never met could challenge their eligibility and get them purged from the voter rolls.
**To protect the basic fairness of our elections, we must stop these attempts to restrict access to the ballot.**
**And we’ve got to act fast.**
**Before the legislative session ends on Friday, it’s all-gas-no-breaks. We’re rallying Georgians to contact their lawmakers and speak out against these bills, we’re lobbying legislators, and we’re raising the alarm about how these new changes would undermine public trust in our elections. **

One bill has already passed the Senate, but this is a fluid situation, so we’re tracking the latest updates on which plans lawmakers will ultimately try to push through both chambers. We’re ready to fight back at a moment’s notice thanks to supporters like you, and this could come down to the very last hours of session tonight. = If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically: | = | = ---|--- = | = ---|--- = | = ---|--- Thank you for powering our work to defend the freedom to vote. With democracy under attack from virtually every angle right now, it’s critical to hold the line for free and fair elections. The Fair Fight Action Team = \-------------------------Forwarded Message------------------------- From: Fair Fight Action Date: Wednesday, April 2 Subject: We must prevent this power grab in Georgia Friday’s the last day of the 2025 legislative session, and Georgia lawmakers are rushing to pass TWO last-minute voter suppression bills. = The bills would make it harder to cast a ballot and easier for extreme activists to challenge Georgians’ right to vote. The provisions would: 1\. Ban Georgians from dropping off mail ballots over the weekend before Election Day — targeting the exact moment when busy people likely have more time to return their ballots. 2\. Allow cuts to Saturday early voting — when many parents, students, caregivers, and folks who work long hours during the week have time to vote — for certain local elections. 3\. Give unelected State Election Board (SEB) members more control over who stays on the voter rolls — rewarding the SEB’s Trump-aligned majority for bending to conspiracy theorists, breaking public trust, and violating the law. 4\. Enshrine policies that bipartisan elections experts have called out as harmful, like mandated video surveillance of absentee ballot drop boxes and expanded partisan poll watcher access to sensitive areas in elections offices. = Let’s be clear: the legislation fits into a broader pattern of voter suppression in Georgia. In the past few years, new laws have made mass voter purges easier, imposed burdensome voter ID requirements, criminalized handing out food and water to voters in line, and placed unnecessary limits on ballot drop boxes. These new provisions, if they pass, would once again make it harder to cast a ballot, especially for voters of color, students, and frequent movers. Everyone should have an equal opportunity to make their voices heard in our democracy. They should be able to vote at a time that fits their schedule. And they shouldn’t have to worry that some partisan activist they’ve never met could challenge their eligibility and get them purged from the voter rolls. To protect the basic fairness of our elections, we must stop these attempts to restrict access to the ballot. And we’ve got to act fast. Before the legislative session ends on Friday, it’s all-gas-no-breaks. We’re rallying Georgians to contact their lawmakers and speak out against these bills, we’re lobbying legislators, and we’re raising the alarm about how these new changes would undermine public trust in our elections. = Thank you, The Fair Fight Action Team = | * 1270 Caroline Street | Suite D120-430 | Atlanta, GA 30307 ©2025 Fair Fight Action - All rights reserved.
