body:
Pre-order my memoir, “Dreaming of Home: A Young Latina’s Journey to Pride, Power, and Belonging” | | | Hello Peter, my name is Cristina Jiménez. I’m a mom, an organizer, co-founder and former executive director of United We Dream, and author of Dreaming of Home. Before I became all of those things, though, I was a young undocumented immigrant living in fear of deportation and family separation, trying to find my voice and a sense of belonging in the U.S. It wasn’t until I met other young immigrants –so many of them like me– who had a fire in them to build a life here that is dignified, where we are safe, and where our humanity is not dictated by whether or not we have a piece of paper, that I realized belonging isn’t something you find. It’s something you build in community with others. It’s something you nurture. During my time with United We Dream, I had the privilege of working with so many immigrant youth from across the country, fighting for racial justice and dignity for our communities and carving out spaces where we could be wholly and authentically ourselves. Our movement changes lives, and that’s why **I’m donating proceeds from my new book,****_Dreaming of Home,_****toward continuing to support our collective fight for justice.** In a time where ICE is targeting our communities for deportation, regardless of immigration status, in schools, churches, and their homes, I offer this book to remind us that we’re not alone and, despite what anyone says, we’re not powerless. It’s my story of being forced to leave Ecuador, growing up undocumented, navigating unjust laws and institutions, and then finding my purpose, love, community, and a movement for justice that opened the hearts of America and changed the lives of millions. This is the book I needed when I was undocumented, afraid, and ashamed. I believe this is the book that America needs right now — as a roadmap to building community, power, and winning real change, even when the world around us seems to be crumbling. This book is for those who are ready and committed to sharing in the responsibility to fight for our collective future where all of us are free.
**[It’s available for pre-order now, Peter. By securing your copy today, you’ll fuel the ongoing fight for immigrant justice at a time when our movement is needed most.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMRElAQir4307E2DEnH_8-JxdZVgzfFjUD7FNlGQzrHOORTFilkfbuLiXFJ0oIAKvKwi_nJ3Yg9IpuQGcyckzvBpM_suPX9s4HrrMmEkOwSD8WkP9SHjDtNCxGKWDMhHWcAnjeBkPEuwaxYYIEdZSYtPWc5r3CncGjP6L_wTDhLJjW74Pp0ctyzze9JiQL1tNOJdLEfT9OhPjt4z8j-rNFrUpU6MXRXWGC5v_ixHAOB8ae0UvY82lyngrWCBAxHhEcgKlQaNKV4RmsKf-MFHpwAhRS4GdOq5iJc_lku4M1LkFhTrMKJAOKCI-d8G-_9r55Hs21pKAzo7LS0ZwJGU1kGZsiI_fzbBYNfFuRON6VMHyv3W1q_WYHF9eATjRjJypXCtzO8YRcKuGiRntMa-6v3I/4fd/CNGsRWoET6iRexHPi-Ptpw/h0/h001.Cz3jv-O0PrRh3jmj27EmY0BnYyEwNg7mpB7pvgEfwoo)** ******[PRE-ORDER NOW****](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMRElAQir4307E2DEnH_8-JxdZVgzfFjUD7FNlGQzrHOORTFilkfbuLiXFJ0oIAKvKwi_nJ3Yg9IpuQGcyckzvBovSQqf0k0aQ6iRyOjM8utgRs3zEsH32a8c21DFq_qJNWr2vHYwFsLD5UShLtXYDDQT9DA6o9e1yyVJi_q3oLV5Djtq2wOBuU78ExEdH19KzA4ZAMlUXH9EYbpIJVrGMuZtNiTFIqgJsVXeK2mTHXg3LGeX0Cwp40j98m1hgz0J1YCDwSIXyS37T5LMjQdMCwreS6N-7-LbIY6oGn_01uV70RDpvW1lYPeqdJRmfJ6WWBQCy3VwiZ4SwoOD1le7OAfn3_xre7ebzKm6-p4m_DShWQe4qK0cVnhFBiwgWs6r8CWLeplRjqGntOdv8WnLibU/4fd/CNGsRWoET6iRexHPi-Ptpw/h1/h001.vXSjyrSSjdonYyWC6lHu3SJiEhtn6m4iryxkcIm8hDo)** I came to the U.S. from Ecuador and grew up undocumented in Queens, N.Y. My experiences, the people I met, and the struggles I faced have shaped me into the person and organizer I am today. In _Dreaming of Home: How We Turn Fear Into Pride, Power, and Real Change,_ I share what it means to find home as an immigrant, even when the world–and the people in positions of power–try to erase us. This story is about **love** , embodied by the parents who make life-changing sacrifices for their children and families to have better lives. It’s a story of **courage** — including the organizers, advocates, lawyers, and undocumented people who are fighting deportations and building a movement with the power to change the lives of millions. And it’s a story about **belonging** and how we, as a country, define love to break through the current toxic narrative around immigration. **

I leave you with this excerpt from my memoir: _“But amidst the sadness of our realities, we also inspire each other and share the amazing fact that the oppression we experience has not killed our spirits or our hope._ _We are young immigrants from different parts of the world, and despite our cultural differences, our stories make us feel connected and safe._ **_We self-organize a space for joy and celebration._**_”_ Sincerely, Cristina Jiménez

clean_body: Pre-order my memoir, “Dreaming of Home: A Young Latina’s Journey to Pride, Power, and Belonging” | | | Hello Peter, my name is Cristina Jiménez. I’m a mom, an organizer, co-founder and former executive director of United We Dream, and author of Dreaming of Home. Before I became all of those things, though, I was a young undocumented immigrant living in fear of deportation and family separation, trying to find my voice and a sense of belonging in the U.S. It wasn’t until I met other young immigrants –so many of them like me– who had a fire in them to build a life here that is dignified, where we are safe, and where our humanity is not dictated by whether or not we have a piece of paper, that I realized belonging isn’t something you find. It’s something you build in community with others. It’s something you nurture. During my time with United We Dream, I had the privilege of working with so many immigrant youth from across the country, fighting for racial justice and dignity for our communities and carving out spaces where we could be wholly and authentically ourselves. Our movement changes lives, and that’s why I’m donating proceeds from my new book,Dreaming of Home,toward continuing to support our collective fight for justice. In a time where ICE is targeting our communities for deportation, regardless of immigration status, in schools, churches, and their homes, I offer this book to remind us that we’re not alone and, despite what anyone says, we’re not powerless. It’s my story of being forced to leave Ecuador, growing up undocumented, navigating unjust laws and institutions, and then finding my purpose, love, community, and a movement for justice that opened the hearts of America and changed the lives of millions. This is the book I needed when I was undocumented, afraid, and ashamed. I believe this is the book that America needs right now — as a roadmap to building community, power, and winning real change, even when the world around us seems to be crumbling. This book is for those who are ready and committed to sharing in the responsibility to fight for our collective future where all of us are free. **** I came to the U.S. from Ecuador and grew up undocumented in Queens, N.Y. My experiences, the people I met, and the struggles I faced have shaped me into the person and organizer I am today. In Dreaming of Home: How We Turn Fear Into Pride, Power, and Real Change, I share what it means to find home as an immigrant, even when the world–and the people in positions of power–try to erase us. This story is about love , embodied by the parents who make life-changing sacrifices for their children and families to have better lives. It’s a story of courage — including the organizers, advocates, lawyers, and undocumented people who are fighting deportations and building a movement with the power to change the lives of millions. And it’s a story about belonging and how we, as a country, define love to break through the current toxic narrative around immigration. Thank you for reading. I leave you with this excerpt from my memoir: “But amidst the sadness of our realities, we also inspire each other and share the amazing fact that the oppression we experience has not killed our spirits or our hope. We are young immigrants from different parts of the world, and despite our cultural differences, our stories make us feel connected and safe. We self-organize a space for joy and celebration.” Sincerely, Cristina Jiménez | Follow us on: | | | | |

This is our chance to right the wrongs of the past few years.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the previous administration used the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dared to stand up for our constitutional liberties. **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue.

Your responses will help Hillsdale improve its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including teaching citizens about the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. You can complete the **National Survey on the Department of Justice** by using the link below: **[https://info.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey](http://links.redconservatives.com/s/c/Y9zzSKMilGpeXRkzzcVyh4DFgihI6D8R5jWex_CqzyD6LmkipsssfRZDdgrjUnnYN3B_XU9CmLMDi7MYb7SZNHRSIBRQ95TPGcKFyEkH5KF0AzoASVDqVIpzgFvasfzn1MlCrY_h3fCa35BlZIcIwf95BpO2_ZgRFS7v3RMGin48jMy5AaAHTEeQrM-pp_ChzqciJQzodlX1dWmuC34WtXJyFFZIoJ1aYLJfdjGOTwmHLYNOODEPNSluZDcK9TXeoC3QIghO9MQfOdq_RUVPOOVtVvsJLTu6BOc8cLemtZEuJib83tDVlVO1ikWw2A6plQkllDVwUgIP3MnA4SlGSRu2m_Nayjq0ziq10L3Dukh8yLSpoBeGoONrMTRBngfKYDtC3kcb2-ePCAJ7PCXmXcSs26zXFhIW9NjIgkZcGTzTGWNIK2Tt-fBIDMAjog/ZOhhQtoo5jNi6wyH28DaVaJd5ajLnNvO/7)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** , and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet, the ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people. Over the last few years, we have experienced a constant attack on our rights--on the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, on due process, on gun ownership, and more. **Today, we are returning to what Abraham Lincoln in his Gettysburg Address called a "government of the people, by the people, for the people."** **That means we have an opportunity to make sure that the weaponization of government _never_ happens again in this country.** Hillsdale College is a leader in this fight--we are **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens with the **truth** about America's great heritage of liberty. We are working to expand our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Revive and Preserve Liberty through Education.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
****

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.7 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
****

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
****

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've experienced over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So, please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept **even one penny** of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://info.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey](http://links.redconservatives.com/s/c/2HqboIJBJtnCx-0C0Iw6VJZfdsHy3AgLkJbgd3vkOJbbNf5_tz0U8JXtAjU6GJsPtrQOPMblht6p2wK26_1EZAkaajAngAYCxo9m5PE0IM067yZvHqAbcP_wNbHbDLSvqY6Jfua9Bt_PP_JjIjPpCfZ-XJDaXCY6ERAuX2SGK_12iWb7Y3ze4biLhD3k8UEKUQGKtuFBp91NO_m9eYF7boO2JEWJmJobBOH8oMBFA0VjAb-OpyGfR7D7eD7zECbewKrqiaUymYXdmakBz1lX2yYE1T7csg0WwVyl-WgePIt19Hgdq7ZC0yy9hQw1mY7083BHY6nzB7wA31b4F8_eCp2f1_UscNDaqEWZJXwPJw_lvQBlgRfpHkI6Mg-bBubhcExGZ1r_9UGqzQJ2xkSHYRF_EZOX8xgQgft9mQ7RvqKqg1MQpXyq0XSsE6AdFw/fgYFxQZTp-BNyVuNpw_KTwVTr3CLPzru/7)** Thank you for your time and attention. In Wisconsin, Elon Musk tried to – literally – buy a state Supreme Court seat on Tuesday, but voters showed up to prove that our democracy is not for sale. Musk made this the most expensive judicial race in history – spending over $25 million, but in the end, he couldn't buy this seat. In Pennsylvania, Democrats maintained control of the state House by winning a critical seat – thanks to a strong campaign focused on working families. At the same time, Cory Booker held the floor of the Senate for more than 25 hours – beating the record held by segregationist Strom Thurmond – arguing that the Trump/Musk agenda is based on corruption, bigotry, and lining the pockets of billionaires. Cory Booker said in his speech: "This is not a left or right moment. It is a right or wrong moment." He's exactly right. This isn't a fight between Republicans and Democrats – it's a fight for the values and principles that define us as Americans. I promise this: I will never fold in the face ofright-wing extremism, and I will always fight for my values and for you. We're in an uphill battle, but this kind of solidarity and organization is going to take back our country. When we stand up to these people just like Cory Booker and Wisconsin and Pennsylvania voters did, we will win. = = I hope you feel just as renewed and resolved as I am that we should never water down our message or compromise our values. body:

Folks,
When my grandfather, Hilary H. Jones Sr., wanted to become an attorney, he couldn’t go to law school in Virginia because schools wouldn’t admit Black people. He had to borrow bar exam practice books from other students because law libraries refused to loan them to him, but he never gave up. He became a pioneering civil rights attorney.
My father, Jerrauld, had to pass a special test for Black students to attend his public elementary school. He had slurs and rocks thrown at him, but he never gave up, either. He graduated from law school and has served Virginia in all three branches of government.
When I look at my childhood photos, I understand why they never gave up – even when the odds were against them: they weren’t just fighting for themselves. They were fighting so that I – and every child across Virginia – wouldn’t have to face the discrimination they did.
Before I go on, can you chip in just $5 to my campaign for Virginia Attorney General today? Like my family, I have always faced injustice head-on, and that’s what is driving my fight to become the Commonwealth’s AG. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_jones_em_q22025?amount=5]
DONATE $5 NOW → [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_jones_em_q22025?amount=5]
DONATE ANOTHER AMOUNT NOW → [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_jones_em_q22025?amount=5]
Even today, Virginia’s legal system contains holdovers from Jim Crow laws. Voting rights are under attack. And every day, I see ways in which those in power are threatening the freedoms that my family – and so many others – fought to protect.
As Attorney General, I will stand up against any threat to our rights so my sons – and all children across the Commonwealth – can have a better life.
Folks, can you please support my campaign with a gift of $5 – or anything you can spare – today? Your donation will make a huge impact on my ability to win my tough race. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_jones_em_q22025?amount=5]

# HB 3928 - Build Oregon Rural Housing Now
On Monday, I introduced the Build Oregon Rural Housing Now (BORHN) Act. The BORHN Act is an opportunity for the legislative assembly to get outside of the box which has curtailed any real solutions of our current housing crisis in Oregon. I have spent many years dealing with land use and housing in Oregon. The conversation always fails in the same place and we need new inventive ways to add land to our buildable options in Oregon without compromising prime productive farmland. You can watch the testimony[ here.](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Folis.oregonlegislature.gov%2Fliz%2Fmediaplayer%3FclientID=4879615486%26eventID=2025031313%26startStreamAt=4314%26stopStreamAt=4614/1/0101019601c49252-f351360b-e17c-4ab7-859d-b3c57ced1f60-000000/bYXSBGq1N3H-6e3EeZhp-HJCiGyKQy33LVCqpozcnMI=399) |
* * *
---
# Managing Federal Forests in Oregon
Thursday I introduced House Bill 3846 which would allow the State Forestry Department to enter into a lease agreement for management authority and responsibility for the Ochoco National Forest for no less than 15 years.
You can [watch my testimony online.](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fwatch%3Fv=q0vksOIo-A4/1/0101019601c49252-f351360b-e17c-4ab7-859d-b3c57ced1f60-000000/LHaGZ-R-vuNYp7mhwInNZLdAjQYGP6qpb48x_ublxA8=399)
For Immediate Release
April 4, 2025
Contact: Reagan Knopp Reagan.Knopp@oregonlegislature.gov
Rep. Breese Iverson Urges Creative Solutions on Federal Lands to Prevent Catastrophic Wildfires
Salem, OR — Today, the House Committee on Climate heard House Bill 3846. The bill creates a pilot program that allows the Oregon Department of Forestry to enter into a lease agreement with the federal government to manage the Ochoco National Forest.
“The overarching fact in Oregon around federal lands is very clear; Federal government has mismanaged our forests causing major wildfires, roads being locked up and lost recreational opportunities that destroy local economies. Simply put, they have lost their way; and therefore have lost the right to manage our forests” said Rep. Breese Iverson (R-Prineville)
House Bill 3846 only has until April 9th to move forward this legislative session before falling victim to the first chamber deadline.
“Too many of our megafires are starting on federal land and burning up our rural communities. If we can manage the forests, we will get control of the fires. We can not afford them, nor should we have to.”
Rep. Vikki Breese Iverson represents House District 59 which includes Crook County and parts of Deschutes and Jefferson counties.
* * *
---
# Realtor Day at the Oregon State Capitol
| | On March 19th, the state Capitol welcomed over 400 Realtors to the building! It is always a welcome site to have so many folks join together in one place to support their industry. Did you know Oregon Realtors are one of the largest trade associations with the most diverse membership in the state? Working with them is always a pleasure! I got to tour some Prineville Realtors through the Oregon House Chamber. What a fun day to have a little bit of my hometown in Salem! Pictured with me is Jessica Lay, Ali Alire and Sheena York
---|---|---
* * *
---
# Rangeland Fire Protection Associations
March 25th welcomed Rangeland Fire Protection Associations to the Capitol. Several Rangeland Fire vehicles were on display outside the Capitol as well as many volunteers of various associations were in the building to support HB 3349 and HB 3350, which will provide opportunity for these volunteer associations to continue the great work they do each year to stop the growth of wildfire in rural Oregon. I continue to be a huge fan of our RFPA's as they show up first during our wildfire season with the intent to extinguish fires. They are the crews who interface with locals and know the terrain when wildfire crisis occurs.
Pictured with me is Ted Netter from the Lower Bridge RFPA in House District 59, it is always wonderful to have constituents in Salem!
We can help RFPAs by supporting [HB 3349](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Folis.oregonlegislature.gov%2Fliz%2F2025R1%2FMeasures%2FOverview%2FHB3349/1/0101019601c49252-f351360b-e17c-4ab7-859d-b3c57ced1f60-000000/3uP_10STf67wWEIpe2AvANrRvZ9jscx7mJZh26sIyko=399) and [HB 3350](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Folis.oregonlegislature.gov%2Fliz%2F2025R1%2FMeasures%2FOverview%2FHB3350/1/0101019601c49252-f351360b-e17c-4ab7-859d-b3c57ced1f60-000000/E125OeCZ7LOPWY8VCJp7vwCD5-X9yUM6TxRRM3t5GfE=399) this session.
* * *
---
# House Bill 3136-A Passes the House Floor
House Bill 3136-A which removes the requirement that a maximum of two real estate professionals may serve on a city or county planning commission for commissions with more than five members.
HB 3136-A keeps the current law for small planning commissions of five members, but removes the discriminatory provisions for larger planning commissions of seven or nine members. This bill makes our laws clear and equitable, still preserving local control.
Local governments can decide the definition of occupation and ultimately retain the final check and balance: deciding who to appoint to their planning commissions.
You can watch my full testimony [here](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Folis.oregonlegislature.gov%2Fliz%2Fmediaplayer%3FclientID=4879615486%26eventID=2025041103%26startStreamAt=2595%26stopStreamAt=2782/1/0101019601c49252-f351360b-e17c-4ab7-859d-b3c57ced1f60-000000/T9mjooniB1SzILiuDGRjukK6Vp1ESPnOGyIMotce2iY=399)
* * *
---
# National Federation of Republican Women
| | I was so happy to see the Federation of Republican Women in the Capitol today! The National Federation of Republican Women is the largest grassroots Republican Women's organization in the country with tens of thousands of active members in local clubs across the nation.

body:
The public lands you and I care for so deeply are under threat.
# [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/133?t=1&akid=1125%2E400544%2En151ix)
[**I’m emailing today to ask you to make your first-ever $5 contribution to our campaign so we can win this race and protect our public lands.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250404_1_publiclands?amount=5&refcode=em20250404-1125&refcode2=1125_400544_n151ix&akid=1125%2E400544%2En151ix)
First, I hope you’ll give me a moment to tell you why the fight to protect our public lands is so personal for me.
Thirty-five generations ago, my ancestors lived in the high desert of New Mexico. Growing up fishing with my dad and running through the desert with my cousins, I learned early on that we all have a responsibility to take care of our planet.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250404_1_publiclands?amount=5&refcode=em20250404-1125&refcode2=1125_400544_n151ix&akid=1125%2E400544%2En151ix)_As Secretary of the Interior, I got to meet with dedicated park staff in Olympic National Park._
I carried my devotion to our land, wildlife, and natural resources with me to Congress, and then to the U.S. Department of the Interior. I’m so proud that, over four years, we protected more lands and waters – _674 million acres_ – than any other administration in history.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250404_1_publiclands?amount=5&refcode=em20250404-1125&refcode2=1125_400544_n151ix&akid=1125%2E400544%2En151ix)_I visited Joshua Tree National Park to discuss the threats climate change poses to our parks._
**Right now, the public lands you and I care for so deeply are under urgent threat.** Donald Trump and Elon Musk have made it clear they intend to auction off our lands to extractive industries like Big Oil. They’ve attempted to fire our dedicated National Parks and National Forests workers en masse.
**With Trump in the White House, governors will be the first line of defense against these brazen attacks on our beloved public lands.** Thousands of people across the country have already stepped up in protest against the exploitation of our parks – and together, our voices are already making a powerful difference.

As governor, I will be a fierce defender of our rivers, mesas, farmlands, and forests, but I can’t win without your support.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250404_1_publiclands?amount=5&refcode=em20250404-1125&refcode2=1125_400544_n151ix&akid=1125%2E400544%2En151ix)**

clean_body: The public lands you and I care for so deeply are under threat. First, I hope you’ll give me a moment to tell you why the fight to protect our public lands is so personal for me. Thirty-five generations ago, my ancestors lived in the high desert of New Mexico. Growing up fishing with my dad and running through the desert with my cousins, I learned early on that we all have a responsibility to take care of our planet. Secretary of the Interior, I got to meet with dedicated park staff in Olympic National Park. I carried my devotion to our land, wildlife, and natural resources with me to Congress, and then to the U.S. Department of the Interior. I’m so proud that, over four years, we protected more lands and waters – 674 million acres – than any other administration in history. visited Joshua Tree National Park to discuss the threats climate change poses to our parks. Right now, the public lands you and I care for so deeply are under urgent threat. Donald Trump and Elon Musk have made it clear they intend to auction off our lands to extractive industries like Big Oil. They’ve attempted to fire our dedicated National Parks and National Forests workers en masse. With Trump in the White House, governors will be the first line of defense against these brazen attacks on our beloved public lands. Thousands of people across the country have already stepped up in protest against the exploitation of our parks – and together, our voices are already making a powerful difference. Be fierce, Deb

We wanted to make sure you saw our message from earlier this week about Donald Trump’s dangerous executive order that threatens to disenfranchise millions.
Trump’s order could:
❗Require people to show a passport or proof of citizenship to register to vote with a national voter registration form
❗ Strip power from states to manage their own elections.
❗ Prohibit states from accepting ballots after Election Day.
We can’t let this happen. Add your name to stand against this executive order and protect voting rights! [https://secure.ngpvan.com/JhutiKu4pkipF6UkmO7C7Q2]
Thank you for taking action to defend our democracy.
– Team Jena

Peter –
Last week, Trump signed an executive order that could disenfranchise millions of voters. This order would make it harder for Americans across the nation to register to vote.
This order continues Trump’s pursuit of the Big Lie and voter suppression efforts. This has been Trump’s game since he lost in 2020.
Jena was interviewed on MSNBC talking about this unlawful order. Watch her interview here. [https://www.facebook.com/share/v/1A5sZUEKLt/]

As Secretary of State, Jena has fought hard to make our elections more secure, accessible, and fair. We’ve expanded voter access, implemented automatic voter registration, and ensured that every eligible Coloradan can cast their ballot safely and easily.
Trump and his allies are trying to roll that progress back.
We must stick together in this fight for democracy.
– Jena For CO

| | Dear Peter,
---
In 2024, one of the deadliest earthquakes of our generation rocked Turkey. We put out a call and sent a team—and we’ve been there ever since. Through our international missions arm, _Light A Candle_ , we are able to be the hands and feet of Jesus to the world! You see, many people __**THINK**__ they know Derrick’s story based on the headlines and newspapers. _“January 6th Insurrectionist.”_ _“Redneck from West Virginia.”_ The media is going to say what it wants. But I know the real Derrick, and _I want you to know him too_. Derrick was my college sweetheart. He was one of the few **pro-life conservatives** I met on campus—passionate, kind, and full of conviction.
---
[](https://links.conservativesgive.com/s/c/g7oPOJOvKzWCNYEDWR-PLJaEvvWp5CaDNkTyCpKTI9m7H6cWdUMy3o5T8ovGLHwUbHhpo0ReJApLB6ZaC6dpstGu4DBFeksuDkdj7bsjO7PhfJgKd_X6-DW2xSOH1I1Dxhfz5gNDBGwRnNcmWGyL3oUqFYOW30ViTYJr1MNpW9MqGDl9A5gm5VmRZU3onH_cw00ZLRC42XuSY8Rmo56eT5G8fRe0MeTzJHMWl6rheXdxPXYifS37IVZrp_NEB0yXgv8lx2mjIz3YnoKaPKTskyGK2gQCN_cnqiGtpnNcm2tQlqUA-GPAOj8Mart9t8Sa8MiB4o0p54TOsoceAGAjxRLSORtGQAJ9P-hghjmCxG0KyKm8IiSazEECm9XoBhjL4XzPAQLXEYWjDY_mCUdBhe4jOyCzi917kKsLlzDqMeEBMKVbyRiNSmosWZsmUegRuSxqsiJLkbJAa9-ub0pa-BEdLzKu1DebNdCHanTblA/Cf9z9OC7CQcittcFPx-JQ30WohwBuT0a/7)
---
When we got married, we lived a normal American life. We had kids running around. Derrick was working on homes, helping out at the family ranch, even volunteering at rehab facilities across West Virginia – __a state ripped apart by opioids and alcoholism__. On top of running for local office, he also helped coached D1 football. Beyond the wins and losses, he wanted to teach young men how to __be good fathers, American__ ____patriots, and strong leaders__. But that all changed in a blink of an eye. **The life Derrick created for our family was** **FLIPPED UPSIDE DOWN OVERNIGHT.** **A SWAT team of Biden's FBI agents****busted down our front door. ** The kids were screaming. Derrick had his hands up. **I was CONFUSED, living in a NIGHTMARE.** Then I remembered – _Derrick went to Washington DC on January 6th to PEACEFULLY contest a stolen election_. _That’s what this was all about_. The Biden Regime labeled him an “insurrectionist” and that was it. **My husband was going to prison.** We tried to fight back. We argued entrapment. We argued violation of free speech. Nothing worked. The courts REFUSED to hear it. **Derrick’s fate was SEALED. ** He would be spending his nights in a cold, dark prison cell. I would be laying in bed alone wondering how I'm going to take care of four kids by myself. Months later, when Derrick was released on good behavior, _the man I saw come home was different_. He always had an interest in politics, _but going to prison lit a fire inside of him I had never seen before_.

body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/105186537/537629309/-1080040549?refcode=email-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NmNjN2Q1My03ZTExLWYwMTEtOGIzZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1glQBvjsOb5jZfLgAwSnjMZdCJ3XuHHRwfHveEc6EVQ=) I want to say thank you. First, thank you for helping me reach our online fundraising goal before Monday’s big deadline. It might seem like the next election is far away, but grassroots support right now really, truly matters in our fight to win back the House — and this team has never, not once, let me down. **I wouldn’t be where I am without you.** And second, I want to say thank you for staying in the fight even when what we’re up against is so exhausting, relentless, and infuriating on a daily basis. Donald Trump would do anything to distract from this fact, but it’s true: _**Trump is nowhere near as powerful as he pretends to be, and we’ve shown again and again that he’s beatable when we stand together.**_ Three days ago, Democrats across the country came together to defeat Trump and Musk’s handpicked candidate in a critical Wisconsin Supreme Court election. In the weeks leading up to that race, we flipped tough seats in special elections and local races across the country that no one even thought would be competitive. We’ve also won one court battle after another to stop Trump from abusing his power — beating back some efforts to fire federal workers, steal funding from critical federal programs that families rely on, attack LGBTQ+ Americans, and give away our private information. And we’ve seen, quite frankly, that Elon Musk is toxic, that the American people won’t sit quietly while he tries to steal their Social Security or their health care, and that the public is overwhelmingly on the side of the Democrats who are fighting hard to protect working families. **We’ve got some more very tough fights ahead of us, and I can’t promise we’ll win all of them. But I _can_ promise that I will keep fighting with everything I’ve got to stand up for you and for your democracy. And that, if we stay together in this fight, we will get through this and build a brighter future where right-wing extremists no longer get to control our government.** Thank you, and more to come. -Andrea | | [Donate →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/105186539/537629311/1012014768?refcode=email_040425_thank-you&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NmNjN2Q1My03ZTExLWYwMTEtOGIzZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1glQBvjsOb5jZfLgAwSnjMZdCJ3XuHHRwfHveEc6EVQ=)

95,000 petitions delivered to the Capitol, urging Polis to veto SB25-003
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._AeeQ/seq99a10a9f)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._AeeQ/s2vdb5da627)**
| | Hi friends,
Team RMV here! Heidi will be away for the next couple of weeks as she undergoes major surgery for breast cancer. Please keep her in your prayers. While she recovers, the Rocky Mountain Voice team will continue to bring you daily updates through this podcast and our newsletter. ❤️
Listen to today's **Mountain Minute Podcast** [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._AeeQ/sfs9d9300a8), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._AeeQ/sfgc6940a42) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._AeeQ/s5lc6dcf78c)! Here is a summary of today's top stories:
**🏛️ Colorado Legislative Session Updates...** Nearly 95,000 petitions were delivered to the Capitol urging Governor Polis to [veto SB25-003](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._AeeQ/sdo1bbc9e54), a sweeping gun control bill that critics say imposes unconstitutional barriers on law-abiding citizens. Meanwhile, a lawsuit backed by the Colorado legislature seeks to [dismantle TABOR](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._AeeQ/s4ta7182c4b) itself, with rural leaders calling it a “legislative betrayal” and warning of runaway government spending if voter approval for tax hikes is erased.
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** Douglas County’s sudden push to become [a home rule county](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._AeeQ/sfl74c9892e) has sparked concerns over potential political consequences. Meanwhile, Colorado Democrats are facing a [fresh ethics scandal](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._AeeQ/s6u4d9af9e0) as Rep. Regina English joins a growing list of lawmakers accused of abusing staff, ignoring harassment complaints, and misusing campaign funds.
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** President Trump is teasing a major economic announcement dubbed “Liberation Day,” signaling a [bold new tariff regime](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._AeeQ/sbk4127e908) to reset America’s trade relationships. Confused about what this means? Check out our informative carousel on Instagram for the [TRUTH about tariffs](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._AeeQ/s5lb89aff9b)!
🗣️ **Commentary Spotlight...** And in a hopeful note, David Proctor argues that Colorado’s [conservative comeback](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._AeeQ/s8n5bc8a448) starts with voter turnout and grassroots engagement—because every ballot cast is a step toward reclaiming the state’s future.
_🤦🏼♀️ A quick correction: Yesterday’s newsletter said Republicans flipped two U.S. House seats—Heidi meant to say they held them. She knew that, of course, but it was 5:45am and her brain was moving faster than her fingers. Not to mention she's busy kicking cancer's butt. Consider this your official oops—from Heidi, with love (and humility)._
This is the Mountain Minute for Friday, April 4, 2025.
– Team RMV

[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._AeeQ/s5l7456d774)
A group of conservative leaders took a bold stand for gun rights today at the Colorado State Capitol. Between Rocky Mountain Gun Owners (RMGO) and the Colorado State Shooting Association, nearly 95,000 petitions were delivered on Thursday calling on Governor Jared Polis to veto SB25-003, the controversial “safety training” bill that critics say imposes unconstitutional restrictions on the Second Amendment.
The Capitol demonstration came just one day after Colorado’s Republican congressional delegation issued a formal letter to Governor Polis demanding a veto of SB25-003.
The letter—organized by U.S. Representative Jeff Crank and signed by Lauren Boebert, Jeff Hurd, and Gabe Evans—called the bill “one of the most restrictive gun ownership laws in the United States,” warning it would “empower criminals at the expense of law-abiding citizens.”

The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._AeeQ/sfsd63301de)
|
---
**[AGNC: Democrats’ TABOR lawsuit a “legislative betrayal” against Colorado taxpayers](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._AeeQ/s6hb9e0f77d)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._AeeQ/s9kb11ecaad)
* Colorado Democrats have introduced HJR25-1023, a resolution directing a lawsuit to challenge TABOR’s constitutionality, arguing it violates the U.S. Constitution’s “republican form of government” clause.
* The Associated Governments of Northwest Colorado (AGNC) condemned the move as a “legislative betrayal,” warning it would eliminate voter approval for tax hikes and enable unchecked government spending.
* Since 2019, state spending has surged over 46%, yet Democrats insist Colorado is underfunded—prompting critics to say the state has a spending addiction, not a revenue problem.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._AeeQ/s9u2d277b44)**
|
---
**[Rushed or responsive? Home rule proposal catches Douglas County off guard](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._AeeQ/s1sc0d4c2df)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._AeeQ/sfvd40b1b65)
* Douglas County Commissioners voted to begin the home rule process, catching many residents off guard with little notice, no town halls, and no public survey ahead of the decision.
* Supporters argue it’s a necessary move to push back against Denver’s left-wing overreach and give the county more local control over internal matters like term limits, salaries, and elected offices.
* Critics warn the rushed process could centralize power, reduce voter say in key roles like sheriff, and risk unintended political shifts depending on how the charter is written by a soon-to-be-elected commission.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._AeeQ/s2qd96bc689)**
|
---
**[Proctor: Colorado’s conservative comeback starts at the ballot box](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._AeeQ/s2m3867d085)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._AeeQ/s6o328a127f)
* David Proctor argues that Colorado’s conservative comeback depends on one thing: voter turnout, especially among disengaged Republicans and persuadable independents.
* He calls for modern, community-driven outreach like door-to-door canvassing to energize the base, combat voter apathy, and restore trust in elections.
* Through Colorado First Action, Proctor urges conservatives to show up in every election—because political change starts at the ballot box, not the sidelines.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._AeeQ/s2kcc6cde3f)**

**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._AeeQ/s6n4841bb24)****BY RMV EDITORIAL BOARD****| COMMENTARY | APRIL 2** _Colorado Attorney General Phil Weiser is once again putting his progressive ideology ahead of the Constitution, launching a string of lawsuits aimed at blocking President Donald Trump’s executive orders—orders designed to restore law and order, secure the border, and protect minors from irreversible medical harm._

In this post I want to flesh out some of the many assaults on TABOR and fiscal responsibility the Democrats are cooking up for this legislative session._ __
**[Hancock: SB25-086 tramples the Constitution in the name of control](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._AeeQ/s5i00737f86)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._AeeQ/s5g5e18c9b2)****BY MICHAEL HANCOCK | COMMENTARY | APRIL 2** _In our political age where virtue signaling often masquerades as policymaking, Colorado Senate Bill 25-086, charmingly titled Protections for Users of Social Media, stands as a masterclass in misdirection. Behind its disarming language and so-called concern for user safety lies a deeply troubling expansion of government power—one that threatens to obliterate the digital boundary between individual freedom and state surveillance._

EMILYs List is in the business of making real, lasting change. Our work has radically changed the face of power in this country over the last 40 years — we've raised almost a billion dollars since 1985, and we've helped elect almost 2,000 women to office up and down the ballot nationwide.

What better way to celebrate our 40-year anniversary than by changing the game again?

This time, we're changing how we interact with you — the EMILYs List community, which makes all of our work possible. We've asked for your feedback and you responded, loud and clear. You want more ways to stay connected, but your inbox needs a break, big-time. The current onslaught of emails and texts from political orgs like ours is overwhelming and unsustainable.

We get it, 100%. That's why we started **Friends of the List** , our new sustainer model, which we launched last week. In case you've missed our earlier emails, here's the deal:

When you commit to a monthly contribution of $15 or more, you get:
* Opted out of ALL future email and text fundraising sends (Yes, you read that right. This could be the last fundraising email you ever get from EMILYs List!)
* 20% off everything in our store

| Hi Peter, it’s Deb Haaland. The campaign to become the next governor of my beautiful home state of New Mexico means so much to me — and I’m so proud to have Blue Amp Action on our team. Right now, we’re building a fierce, people-powered, community-centered movement to change the game for New Mexico. But, we’re also facing a big challenge: April 7 marks our first public reporting deadline. And it’s a really important one. You see, we’re facing a competitive and expensive race, with MAGA forces trying to flip control of this state and our state government. If our first fundraising report is weak, it’ll invite far-right smear campaigns, outside spending, and potential right-wing opponents. And with Donald Trump in the White House, we need a fighter who’s fierce enough to stand up for New Mexicans. That’s why my team and I set a very ambitious goal of raising $150,000 online by April 7 to show that momentum and grassroots support are on our side — and it’s why I’m humbly asking: [Can you split a donation of $10 or any amount between my campaign and Blue Amp Action? Your support today will help us post the fiercest fundraising report possible.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T01c903ac-64c6-4c41-8bf6-beb09a3f2134/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

body:

Peter,
I want to thank you from the bottom of my heart for helping our campaign hit our end-of-quarter fundraising goal.
We are up against multiple trade wars, the worst month for stocks in years, rampant and unnecessary layoffs of federal workers, and a future that seems uncertain.
But you all showed up for our people-powered campaign. This was my first end-of-quarter deadline as a member of Congress, and because of your generosity, we will have the resources we need to lay critical groundwork for the months ahead.
The way we fight back is together—and that’s exactly what we’re doing.
Every day I am in Congress, I am fighting to safeguard Medicaid coverage, protect veterans and their benefits, invest in our kids’ health and futures, and pass common-sense gun control—and to prop up the constitutional guardrails that Donald Trump and his cronies are determined to trample.
But I can’t do that alone.
Together, we will stand with our federal workers, teachers, judges, and children to create a government that works for us.
Thank you for being part of this work.
In Solidarity,
Maxine

I'm here on the final day of the 2025 legislative session, reflecting on the insights I've gained over the past three sessions. There's a ton more to unpack, but these are the no-nonsense takeaways that hit the top of the list:
1. Take the single over nothing if you can't get the grand slam (and by the way, the grand slam never happens). If you can move the ball down the field 10 yards it's better than 0 yards.
2. Democrats and Republicans vote the same way about 50% of the time (ish) because we actually agree on a lot of things.
3. A lot of people who think they know how things work, or what's going on with a bill have absolutely no idea what they're talking about. Armchair quarterbacking is easy. Talking shit from the sidelines is common. Getting in the game is a whole different story. Most of the armchair quarterbacks could never even win an election.
4. Pacs, lobbyists, and special interest groups take credit for everything legislators do.
5. Legislators are cattle. We are cattle to the bureaucrats, the lobbyist class, the Pacs, and the special interest groups.
6. Too many folks find their identity in being an "elected official."Instead of something they do, they see it as someone they are. That's not how it is supposed to be.
7. If you spend your time burning bridges and blowing things up, you're not going to get a lot (or, anything) done.
8. Everyone in politics could benefit from the 3 Hs... a hug, a hike, and a hobby.

name: Suzanne Crouch and the Indiana Mental Health Roundtable
subject: Let’s Stay Connected—Our Work Together Is Just Beginning
body:
A Note from Suzanne Crouch and the Indiana Mental Health Roundtable | | | |
---
| | | Dear Friends, Throughout my campaign for governor, I had the privilege of meeting so many passionate Hoosiers who care deeply about the future of our state. Your encouragement and belief in a stronger, healthier Indiana meant the world to me—and while the campaign has ended, our shared work is far from over.

That’s why I’m reaching out today.

As many of you know, mental health has been a cornerstone of my public service. That’s why I founded the **Indiana Mental Health Roundtable (IMHR)** —a coalition designed to bring together leaders across sectors to drive lasting change in how we support mental wellness in Indiana. I had the honor of co-chairing the Roundtable alongside Dr. John Lechleiter, former CEO of Eli Lilly and a passionate mental health advocate, until earlier this year.

Today, IMHR continues to grow and thrive under new leadership, but its purpose remains the same: to convene, advocate, and innovate—aligning, amplifying, and scaling wellness initiatives across our state and beyond.

This mission is more important than ever. From rural communities to urban centers, Hoosiers deserve a mental health system that works for everyone. IMHR is helping to build that system by connecting business, philanthropy, government, and grassroots organizations to develop real solutions that make a real difference.

**I invite you to stay connected and follow our progress.**

One exciting opportunity to get involved is through our upcoming IMHR Summit: The Business of Mental Health, where we’ll bring together business and philanthropic leaders to explore how mental health intersects with workforce, economic development, and community well-being.

Below this message, you’ll find the latest edition of the IMHR Newsletter—featuring stories from across the state—as well as our Summit Sponsor Prospectus, which outlines ways to support this important work.

If you’re interested in getting more involved or learning about how you or your organization can support IMHR, please don’t hesitate to _[reach out to us](mailto:info@mentalhealthroundtable.org)_. Additionally, if you would like to make a direct contribution to support IMHR’s mission, donations can be made through **Sagamore Institute** by visiting _[this link](https://sagamoreinstitute.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e80a6b302e01b93dc55a8086&id=357a2ee863&e=a523619b7b)_.

With gratitude,

# **Indiana Youth Institute Releases
2025 KIDS COUNT® ****Data Book**

With insights aimed to inform and inspire actions to enhance the lives of children statewide, IYI released the.31st Indiana KIDS COUNT® Data Book in February 2025. Offering a comprehensive overview of child well-being across the state, this edition highlights key metrics, including Indiana's national rankings: 15th in Economic Well-Being, 17th in Education, 32nd in Health, and 31st in Family & Community domains. Notably, the data reveals that 29.9% of students in grades 7-12 reported experiencing prolonged periods of sadness or hopelessness in 2024, a decrease from 35.7% in 2022.

clean_body: A Note from Suzanne Crouch and the Indiana Mental Health Roundtable | | | | | | | Dear Friends, Throughout my campaign for governor, I had the privilege of meeting so many passionate Hoosiers who care deeply about the future of our state. Your encouragement and belief in a stronger, healthier Indiana meant the world to me—and while the campaign has ended, our shared work is far from over. That’s why I’m reaching out today. As many of you know, mental health has been a cornerstone of my public service. That’s why I founded the Indiana Mental Health Roundtable (IMHR) —a coalition designed to bring together leaders across sectors to drive lasting change in how we support mental wellness in Indiana. I had the honor of co-chairing the Roundtable alongside Dr. John Lechleiter, former CEO of Eli Lilly and a passionate mental health advocate, until earlier this year. Today, IMHR continues to grow and thrive under new leadership, but its purpose remains the same: to convene, advocate, and innovate—aligning, amplifying, and scaling wellness initiatives across our state and beyond. This mission is more important than ever. From rural communities to urban centers, Hoosiers deserve a mental health system that works for everyone. IMHR is helping to build that system by connecting business, philanthropy, government, and grassroots organizations to develop real solutions that make a real difference. I invite you to stay connected and follow our progress. One exciting opportunity to get involved is through our upcoming IMHR Summit: The Business of Mental Health, where we’ll bring together business and philanthropic leaders to explore how mental health intersects with workforce, economic development, and community well-being. Below this message, you’ll find the latest edition of the IMHR Newsletter—featuring stories from across the state—as well as our Summit Sponsor Prospectus, which outlines ways to support this important work. If you’re interested in getting more involved or learning about how you or your organization can support IMHR, please don’t hesitate to mailto:info@mentalhealthroundtable.org. Additionally, if you would like to make a direct contribution to support IMHR’s mission, donations can be made through Sagamore Institute by visiting . body:
Let me tell you why this news hits close to home for me.
Peter,
If you haven’t already heard by now, Donald Trump and his unelected billionaire sidekick Elon Musk are taking a sledgehammer to the Department of Education.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/87719?refcode=em20250404-8868&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=8868%2E614464%2EbmCdv7)
_I know it can feel overwhelming to keep up with the news. This is too important to ignore._
This news hits close to home for me. Let me tell you why:
**This move hurts students all across New Mexico.** Tragically, New Mexico currently ranks among the worst in the nation when it comes to our elementary and middle school students’ achievement in math and reading. Children in our state are already struggling, and gutting the Education Department could risk federal funds that help every student succeed – regardless of barriers they may face as a result of poverty.
**It hurts low income children like my Somah.** When it was time for Somah to attend preschool, I had no idea how I’d cover the costs. Luckily, I found a school that allowed parents to volunteer cleaning up classrooms in exchange for a discount on tuition. It wasn’t always easy, but it was the only way I could have afforded to send them to preschool.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/87719?refcode=em20250404-8868&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=8868%2E614464%2EbmCdv7) _I cleaned up my child’s preschool to reduce the bill._
**It hurts people like me, who’ve taken on student loans.** Believe it or not, I still owe student loans. I made the decision to take on debt to attend undergrad and law school at UNM, and I swear, some days it feels like I’ll be paying them down forever. People across the country are getting crushed by the weight of student debt, and cutting the Department of Education further endangers critical funding for higher education access.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/87719?refcode=em20250404-8868&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=8868%2E614464%2EbmCdv7) _The day I graduated from UNM in 1994. 30 years later, I’m still paying down student loans._
**I am running for governor because I have lived the struggles that too many people in New Mexico and across the country currently face, and I’m determined to fix what’s broken.** Our children are relying on us to fight for a bright future for them, and that’s what our campaign is about. I know that with Trump in the White House it can feel overwhelming, or like the odds are stacked against us. But if we come together, I know we will win.

name: Derek Lyons - RITE
subject: RITE’s Statement on Ruling in North Carolina Supreme Court Race Contest
body:
Victory on overseas voters who have never resided in North Carolina |
---
| |
---
| | **RITE’s Statement on Ruling in North Carolina Supreme Court Race Contest** (Raleigh, NC – North Carolina) – Restoring Integrity and Trust in Elections (“RITE”), a non-profit organization that supports litigation to protect election security and integrity, issued the following statement in response to the Court of Appeals of North Carolina’s [ruling](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=a9f900dc23&e=ea91f782ea) in Griffin v. North Carolina State Board of Elections that ballots of overseas voters who have never resided in North Carolina are to be excluded from the final count for the contested race for a seat on the state Supreme Court. “RITE is gratified by today’s ruling, which vindicates RITE’s [lawsuit](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=4228b18f60&e=ea91f782ea) brought before the November election that people who have never resided in the state are not constitutionally eligible to vote in North Carolina elections,” said RITE Spokesman Tim Murtaugh. “In October, RITE initiated litigation challenging a state statute permitting overseas voters who have never lived in North Carolina to vote for all offices in the state, including Supreme Court races. In line with RITE’s arguments, the court today correctly held that North Carolina’s constitution clearly – and unsurprisingly – conditions eligibility to vote on being an actual resident of the state. North Carolina’s elections should never be decided by anyone other than North Carolinians. The courts should have resolved this issue when RITE gave them the opportunity before the election, but a right decision late is better than none at all.” RITE also filed amicus briefs in this litigation when it was removed to the [Fourth Circuit Court of Appeals](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=214141c0a1&e=ea91f782ea) and while it was pending, at an earlier stage of the case, before the [North Carolina Supreme Court.](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=73d58cf64a&e=ea91f782ea) ###

Have you ever wondered what it was like to grow up in a Communist, revolutionary hellhole? I don’t have to wonder.| | | Patriot, this is Senator Ted Cruz. This is a longer email – _**[but I can’t emphasize enough how important it is to read every word.](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=7d46678aa7e64cbbb4f4d742af4b355e&_e=KYOUbzU2bLUzvk67F0teCAhppyXnsMiKeFPpcYXOfUgc-qF4vQ5_MDqXumCkKMxjrXj4s83e2z3uxycGqN4F4AP1eMQ998jUNEZgMgb_3V0AP7PaElBFsUKOnxt6QIb_jCguOVqAdYPnnb4-h-RmIdGy5qcA7FKHNBd-HO1QUmaDaiFLAhDRzK73tXbdwJAr4G8HcZKSbqHxdFLhOAUgWEQcyKxGi7slEKJgLFEYmTttZBm1-1XR63KgcupU3TWOVbCdQRmE41ugR4AELywgtzZGaQe-o896-3T5aAwtYvwp0uYVQfZmYSVd-twQctaAbhGAVL9BjYeVVRVrK8qnVw%3D%3D)**_ Have you ever wondered what it was like to grow up in a Communist, revolutionary hellhole? Have you ever wondered what it’s like to be beaten and thrown in jail for disagreeing with your country’s leader? Have you ever wondered what it’s like to watch, helplessly as the country where your parents raised you is ripped apart at the seams by Communist insanity? **_I don’t have to wonder._** **_My dad, Rafael, lived it..._** And as I was growing up he explained every excruciating detail of what it was like when he was growing up in Cuba. Friend, we’re watching the same radical revolutionary playbook in America RIGHT now – **[and we’re running out of time to course-correct.](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=7d46678aa7e64cbbb4f4d742af4b355e&_e=KYOUbzU2bLUzvk67F0teCAhppyXnsMiKeFPpcYXOfUgc-qF4vQ5_MDqXumCkKMxjrXj4s83e2z3uxycGqN4F4AP1eMQ998jUNEZgMgb_3V0AP7PaElBFsUKOnxt6QIb_jCguOVqAdYPnnb4-h-RmIdGy5qcA7FKHNBd-HO1QUmaDaiFLAhDRzK73tXbdwJAr1iB-uPzozrE3L_eRky234-QDwE5X--heZeIHxV6oykbB3TBIJ490dqtBalqU3b16x9EX3a0S-2xuiUcDwx6amLjLIUl_YqDIoP9WOr43gr1Co3IGyUe7CjtUXNr2wvmQpL6LsFuY25qIxFpEpyTSNw%3D%3D)** Rafael Cruz was beaten and thrown in prison. He was so desperate to escape he sowed $100 into his underwear and fled. **_THIS is how the Communist revolution happened in Cuba._** First, radical revolutionaries take TOTAL control over the classroom. They write the textbooks. They craft the lessons. They silence diversity of opinions. And they teach children that the country their parents inherited is EVIL, unjust, and must be destroyed. Then, they separate children from their parents. They attack parental rights. They tell children to REPORT their parents for beliefs that go against the regime. They demand that children abandon the beliefs and traditions of their parents. **_They know that the only way they can push their insane ideology is to isolate and target the most impressionable and vulnerable minds._** And finally, when they’ve run their propaganda campaign across an entire generation of students – they flip the switch and bring down the hammer. All hope is lost. Does that sound frighteningly familiar? It should. It’s happening right under our noses, in plain sight for the world to see. How extreme is Amanda Chase? We don’t know where to begin, but:
* Remember Donald Trump’s January 6, 2021 rally right before the violent insurrection on the U.S. Capitol? Yeah... _**she was there!**_
* The Virginia State Senate later _**censured her**_ for calling those who violently stormed the Capitol “patriots.”
* She literally _**carried a pistol**_ onto the Virginia State Senate floor.
* When it comes to women’s reproductive rights, she supports a total abortion ban with _**no exceptions.**_
* And _**so much more.**_

I’ll always put New Hampshire first.

I’m Congressman Chris Pappas, and Sharice Davids said I could reach out with some big news: **I’m officially running to be New Hampshire’s next U.S. Senator.** I’m going to share more about why I’m in this race, but if you’re already on board, [_**split a contribution to my campaign and Sharice Davids today.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/105194427/537653589/278514719?refcode=email_040425_davids-pappas-split&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500,1000&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMjdlMDYzMy04ZTExLWYwMTEtOGIzZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WMnfMfkjKmNf2Hei7pl3RMO-7GUwbIJYaL2E-ArUxkU=) I’m running for Senate because at this pivotal moment, our economy, our democracy, and our way of life are on the line. New Hampshire deserves a Senator who is grounded in the people, places, and values of this state – and one who is ready to lead on day one. Our country is at a crossroads, and the decisions we make now will have generational impacts. You can count on me to continue taking on big fights and to confront the Trump Administration, self-dealing billionaires, and extreme politicians who are threatening our future and our ability to get things done for New Hampshire. [_**Can I count on you to become a Founding Donor to my campaign with a $25 contribution, split between my campaign and Sharice Davids right now? We can’t win this race without major grassroots support.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/105194428/537653590/278514719?refcode=email_040425_davids-pappas-split&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500,1000&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMjdlMDYzMy04ZTExLWYwMTEtOGIzZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WMnfMfkjKmNf2Hei7pl3RMO-7GUwbIJYaL2E-ArUxkU=) **These fights are deeply personal to me.** My family immigrated from Greece and opened a restaurant in Manchester 108 years ago, a small business that remains at the heart of the community today. Running that small business showed me the power of hard work and serving others, but the opportunity that my ancestors and so many others like them sought has never been further away – and the Trump Administration is too busy cutting deals for their billionaire buddies to give a damn. I’m also openly gay and happily married to my husband, Vann. With the current wave of hateful policies leveled at the LGBTQ+ community, I know how important representation is at this moment. **If elected, I’d be the first openly gay male U.S. Senator in history** – a badge of honor I’d wear proudly as I advocate for full equality. I am the proud product of public education, and I come from a family of business owners _(my grandfather invented the chicken tender at the restaurant – seriously!)_. I understand firsthand the need to support neighborhood schools and small businesses in our community. **These are the lifeblood of our economy and the pillars of opportunity for everyone.** My life experiences are what led me to successfully run for four terms in Congress and win in one of the “swingiest” districts in the nation. Before I won my election in 2018, no one had managed to hold the seat for more than one term for more than a decade. I’m no stranger to tough electoral fights. **Now I’m ready to take on the fight to keep New Hampshire’s Senate seat blue.** We can’t afford to sit on the sidelines of the big fights ahead – not with so much at stake, from the rising costs debilitating working families to the threats to the future of our democracy. We’ve taken on big fights together in Congress. Now it’s time to win this critical Senate seat so we can keep standing up to the Trump Administration and the self-dealing billionaires threatening our future. Can I count on you to join the fight? [_**If you’re with me, let’s make a powerful statement together and prove that we’re ready to win this race. Become a Founding Donor with a $25 donation to my campaign and Sharice Davids now.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/105194429/537653591/278514719?refcode=email_040425_davids-pappas-split&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500,1000&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMjdlMDYzMy04ZTExLWYwMTEtOGIzZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WMnfMfkjKmNf2Hei7pl3RMO-7GUwbIJYaL2E-ArUxkU=) Thank you again to Sharice for letting me reach out today. With gratitude, Chris [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/105194430/537653592/278514719?refcode=email_040425_davids-pappas-split&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500,1000&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMjdlMDYzMy04ZTExLWYwMTEtOGIzZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WMnfMfkjKmNf2Hei7pl3RMO-7GUwbIJYaL2E-ArUxkU=)

| | _**Empowering Hoosiers**_
---
Friends, Governor Braun and his administration have continued this week at full speed, delivering on his promises to improve education, streamline government services, and protect Hoosiers. Governor Braun announced new partnerships to better connect students with career opportunities, ensuring they are prepared for success whether they choose college, the workforce, or military service. These new partnerships and will better our students for whatever future they choose, and are key to Governor Braun's Freedom and Opportunity Agenda for education. Governor Braun also issued two executive orders modernize and improve the Bureau of Motor Vehicles and the transportation permitting process, placing customer service at the forefront of his administration view towards state services. Following yesterday's severe storms, Governor Braun activated the Indiana National Guard to aid in recovery efforts for all impacted Hoosiers. Our representatives in the General Assembly have also been hard at work, sending bills to Governor Braun's desk aimed at increasing government efficiency, protecting the rights and safety of Hoosiers, and more. Our Republican leadership has taken decisive action to support, protect, and empower Hoosiers, and the Indiana GOP is proud to stand with them in these efforts. As always, thank you for being a part of our team. Please feel free to reach out if there's anything I can assist with.

| | Lana Keesling, Indiana GOP Chairwoman

**SEA 222:** Limits how a legal services provider may use funds from the civil legal aid fund. Relocates a provision concerning fund distribution. Repeals the distribution formula of the civil legal aid fund statute. Requires the office of judicial administration to annually report certain information regarding the civil legal aid fund to the state budget committee. **SEA 421****:** Updates Indiana's publication procedures for IURC hearings, allowing notices in print or electronic editions if newspapers publish less than three times a week, and replaces references to "stenographer" with "court reporter" in utility regulations. It also repeals obsolete provisions on alternative energy projects and increases civil penalties for pipeline safety violations to align with federal standards. **SEA 422:** Defines "advanced transmission technologies" and requires electric utilities to include plans for their use in integrated resource plans (IRPs) filed after 2025 and 2029. It also mandates an IURC study on these technologies, with findings reported in 2026, and allows cost recovery for related investments. **SEA 199:** Provides that two or more candidates of a political party may sign a written statement indicating their desire to name a watcher to be present at a county primary election. Allows a county chairman of a political party to appoint a watcher to each precinct in which the political party has a candidate on the ballot if two or more candidates do not sign a written statement to request a watcher. **SEA 211:** Permits the use of funds from the clean water Indiana fund to manage invasive plant species. **SEA 314:** Provides various tax exemptions for the Women's National Basketball Association All-Star Game, including ancillary events, when held in Indiana. **SEA 477:** Clarifies state ownership of low head dams, allows certain removals without a permit, sets warning sign standards, permits a $1 million bond for financial responsibility, and extends permit validity for dam removals. **HEA 1012: **Mandates that by July 1, 2026, law enforcement agencies must adopt protocols to notify property owners of accident-related damage or debris on their property. **HEA 1095:** Provides that the Indiana crime guns task force area may include Lake County. Increases the number of executive board members required for a quorum from five to seven. Specifies that the position for which the chairperson voted prevails in the case of a tie vote as long as that position has received the affirmative votes of at least four members of the executive board. **HEA 1132:** Provides that the Indiana finance authority is required to provide staff support for the Indiana stadium and convention building authority board. **HEA 1196:** Provides that an eligible entity with a population of less than 38,000 is not subject to the political party membership requirements for a board of aviation commissioners or an airport authority.

## Dachshund Survives 16 Months in Wild
A miniature dachshund named Valerie has survived 16 months alone in the rugged wilderness of Kangaroo Island, off Australia's southern coast, after escaping during a family camping trip in November 2023. ## Dachshund Survives 16 Months in Wild
A miniature dachshund named Valerie has survived 16 months alone in the rugged wilderness of Kangaroo Island, off Australia's southern coast, after escaping during a family camping trip in November 2023. Take a [look at the photos of the pup here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyckbGuozAQRb8GuomMcXAoKLahe9tuiSaZAc_K2JE9BOXvVy_FfsDrr47u0fnztXyhREnbb9x5Wrd10TUvhI9Qw5FIkgY-JdKdVd-FF2vsFYwD4xZCie_FtTStzJb7lqfOu96P3o5jG6bBW0dkXD90nenQkF0Ndr7nK13RDn0r0zfNOOOsMbfOX4bR9_ZmyXt3dXeixhkm0Vwuf_PnyRrf-cXl8sh7G6eg-qxN_6uxc2Pn8zwvdRcNNSfBtOP2PWvsXHcsConP2thZg1Rg2YLCMx-JYJckqEdh-C8N9SgveTFBN8Cek4YKOQFCObaNCfCoWjAKJpAaMRHcD4UaGM6cFCIrFK6Pg0uFBz4_8MAFupsZb0PvhsbObZnoeUqMUgffOLPtKPHjpT-r8JrsvwAAAP__GLqbiw). Her owners, visiting from Broken Hill--about 850 miles away--left her in a playpen while they went fishing. Valerie slipped out and disappeared into the bush. They searched for days but eventually had to return home. Despite harsh terrain, predators, and ongoing rescue efforts, the 8-pound dog has evaded capture. Volunteers from [Kangala Wildlife Rescue](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJycz7GOqzAQheGnsbsgMzY2FC5uQ5fbbmkZZgyzayACJxFvvyKPsP3Rr-983cM9cuZ1-h8X8mlKoaQtYBznY36uyGuZ6c0ZByrl3CmAguamzE2ZgJHzGYxEn4iAtCRfO6Nd56Dr5Oyb1FrnaLBoo60NaJ201dTaUdumG7Vkf9WUUQaUamtX2c5paAGdM40ZEIVRhFy2vfrePpKUz-1FezVui8x-LuVxCP1PQC-g_4nrFHO8sJkT7XSMT7qWAnq5e3y8OWc-rBNGTUvk_KmUv31-efgNAAD__4G8Zrs) continue tracking her using cameras and food traps, hoping to bring her home. Though her survival is surprising, experts say dachshunds are tough and resourceful.

| Hi Peter, it’s Deb Haaland. The campaign to become the next governor of my beautiful home state of New Mexico means so much to me — and I’m so proud to have the Democratic Party of Georgia on our team. Right now, we’re building a fierce, people-powered, community-centered movement to change the game for New Mexico. But, we’re also facing a big challenge: **April 7 marks our _first_ public reporting deadline. And it’s a really important one.** You see, we’re facing a competitive and expensive race, with MAGA forces trying to flip control of this state and our state government. **If our first fundraising report is weak, it’ll invite far-right smear campaigns, outside spending, and potential right-wing opponents. | Neighbor,
The residents of Michigan’s 35th State Senate District—Midland, Bay, and Saginaw counties—have been without representation in the Senate for over 75 days, the longest stretch in recent history without a special election being called—because Governor Gretchen Whitmer has refused to act.
Meanwhile, Governor Gretchen Whitmer has found time for two international trips—first to Dubai, and now to the U.K. and Ireland—yet she still has not acted to restore full representation to the people of the 35th Senate District.
Her silence speaks volumes.
The reality is this: Governor Whitmer is trying to protect the Democrats’ narrow 19–18 majority in the Senate. With Republicans now in control of the House, she’s clinging to what little power she has left—even if it means leaving 260,000 people in the 35th District without a voice in Lansing.
This isn’t about politics. It’s about basic democratic representation. The residents of the 35th deserve the same voice in Lansing that every other Michigander enjoys. Every day this seat goes unfilled is another day their concerns go unheard.
We urge you to stand with us in demanding action. Call Governor Whitmer at 517-335-7858 or 517-373-3400 and sign the petition at [freethe35th.com](https://takeitbackmi.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f3a7dccdb3ca90c7483cf93d3&id=8393b40f24&e=9ec31248a9).
Tell the Governor to put people over politics. The time to act is now.
In service,

## **The People 's Briefing Room: Why It's Time to End the WHCA's Stranglehold**
If you needed any more proof that Washington elites think they own the place, look no further than the latest tantrum from the White House Correspondents' Association (WHCA) over the White House press office taking back control of the briefing room seating chart.
That's right--for decades, this taxpayer-funded space has been controlled not by the American people, not even by the White House itself, but by a group of self-important, self-serving journalists who act like the briefing room is their private clubhouse.
Well, those days are over. And it's about time.
### **The WHCA: Gatekeepers for the Media Elite**
For years, the WHCA has operated as an exclusive club for left-wing legacy media outlets. They decide who sits where, who gets a prime spot, and who is shoved to the back or outright excluded.
Independent journalists, conservative outlets, and rising media voices?
Good luck.
The WHCA has long operated as a gatekeeper, ensuring that only their preferred "establishment-approved" voices have the best access to the White House press secretary.
This isn't a conspiracy theory; it's a fact.
The WHCA literally limits who can join their organization. They control access to becoming a member, making it incredibly difficult for independent journalists to get a seat at the table--or, in this case, literally a seat in the room.
And when the Biden administration, under Karine Jean-Pierre, revoked the hard passes of over 400 independent journalists, the WHCA didn't say a word. Not one.
Think about that for a moment.
The supposed defenders of press access, the champions of "democracy dies in darkness," stood by silently while hundreds of reporters were stripped of their ability to hold the Biden White House accountable.
But of course, that's because they aren't interested in press freedom--they're interested in protecting their own access and influence...

In the summer of 1990, Raul walked in the desert heat from business to business in the Coachella Valley asking them to invest in their community by contributing to his education. Team — The gun violence epidemic is the leading cause of death for American kids. Instead of addressing this crisis, Donald Trump is making it worse.

The Trump administration removed a public health advisory that called out gun violence in the United States for what it is: a crisis.

Why? Because he’s more concerned with protecting the gun lobby’s profits than protecting our families.

Jason has carried weapons of war as an Army Ranger. He’s seen firsthand the devastating power of these firearms, and he knows they have no place in our communities. That’s why he’s spent his time in Congress fighting for commonsense gun safety reforms, including:

- Universal background checks
- A ban on military-grade weapons
- Keeping guns out of the hands of domestic abusers

We’ve made progress. When Jason was first elected, he helped pass the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act , the most significant gun safety legislation in nearly 30 years.

But Trump and his allies are doing everything they can to undo that progress: Trump’s latest move is a backslide on the work we’ve done to address the gun violence epidemic — and even Trump’s health secretary RFK Jr. has stated that he does not see gun violence as a public health crisis.

President Trump’s Elections Executive Order is yet another illegal power grab and an attack on our free and fair elections.
# [](https://act.robbonta.com/go/3?refcode=em20250404&t=1&akid=1724%2E1088799%2EWTL6ZO)
I just filed my **10th lawsuit against the Trump administration** for yet another unconstitutional, anti-democratic, and un-American executive action.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-20250404?refcode=em20250404-1724&amount=5&refcode2=1724_1088799_WTL6ZO&akid=1724%2E1088799%2EWTL6ZO)
This time, I’m suing to stop President Trump’s illegal Elections Executive Order that would impose sweeping and unnecessary **voting restrictions nationwide that could disenfranchise millions of voters.**
**[If you’re with me in this fight to protect our fundamental voting rights, pitch in →](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-20250404?refcode=em20250404-1724&amount=5&refcode2=1724_1088799_WTL6ZO&akid=1724%2E1088799%2EWTL6ZO)**
Trump is trying to require voters to provide proof of citizenship documentation to register to vote in federal elections, ban states from counting absentee or mail-in ballots that arrive after Election Day, and more. On top of that, he’s threatening to withhold funding from states that don’t comply.
Voting is the lifeblood of democracy, yet Trump is abusing his power to make it harder for eligible Americans, including troops overseas, to cast their ballots in our free and fair elections, all under the guise of ‘election security’ and debunked conspiracy theories.
**Once again, this executive order is a massive power grab by Trump:** the President doesn’t have the power to rewrite states’ election laws or modify the rules Congress has created for elections.
**[We will not be bullied by him, and we will fight like hell in court to stop him. If I have your support, can you chip in $5 to fuel our grassroots campaign?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-20250404?refcode=em20250404-1724&amount=5&refcode2=1724_1088799_WTL6ZO&akid=1724%2E1088799%2EWTL6ZO)**
