As long as Trump and his administration continue to violate the law at the expense of the American people, I will be here ready to hold him accountable and fight for our freedoms.
In solidarity,
Rob

As many of you know, it's been a tough week for my family and I. Especially in times like this, I believe it is even more important to celebrate the good things in life. Today I want to share one of those good things, _**one that you made possible**_.
Due to your gracious support, subscriptions, and shares, I just got word that _Let 's Address This with Qasim Rashid_ is now officially ranked **#71 among all political platforms on Substack.** Outstanding!
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c22a8905-ffdf-4e2b-ac74-6ad735798107?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
For perspective, there are more than 17,000 writers on Substack, and the Politics section is by far their largest cohort of writers. That makes our #71 rank that much more remarkable. Due to your support, we're currently ahead of major names like Thom Hartmann, Ann Coulter, and Van Jones. And we're just a few spots behind heavy hitter journalists like Joy Ann Reid. This ranking is thanks to you--the 124,000+ readers who are showing up, reading, sharing, and demanding better.
And guess what? We've achieved all of this without a single billionaire dollar. No corporate sponsorships. No PR machine. Just the power of truth, justice, and people who refuse to be silent in the face of fascism.
We're writing daily on the issues corporate media refuses to touch--state violence, genocide, book bans, judicial corruption, and the gutting of our democracy. And we're doing it with the clarity, compassion, courage, and with the meaningful calls to action necessary to counter the injustices we face.
Our one-year anniversary is coming up on **April 23** --and with your help, my hope is for us to crack the **Top 50** and continue to rise. But that won't happen on its own. That will require each of your collective effort.
**So, today, I ask you to take one, two, or all three of the actions below.**
1. 📬 If you're not subscribed yet--now's the time.

2. 📢 If you're already subscribed, please share this newsletter with someone you care about and ask them to subscribe, for free or as a paid subscriber.

[Share Let's Address This with Qasim Rashid](https://substack.com/redirect/ad7c39ab-c3ab-406c-92d9-7017042858fd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
3. 🎁 Or, if you're feeling generous towards a friend or family member, consider gifting them subscription to help us grow.

[Give a gift subscription](https://substack..AzKeMxzzVfLI8YS1uVnw4i_75QW5jLmZxk-fgD7pjYU?&gift=true)
I consider it an honor that after 1 month of subscribing, **more than 99% of our paid subscribers remain subscribed**. We know our ideas win when people hear them--so help me make sure people hear them. Let's keep building this community, keep raising our voices, and keep showing what's possible when We the People lead. Take one, two, or all three of the calls to action listed above--I would be most grateful.
And from the bottom of my heart, thank you.
With peace,
**Qasim**

CNN's Kaitlan Collins **[confronted](https://substack.com/redirect/e28d11e9-3224-4278-8b92-1e14e05b4ecb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** former Kamala Harris supporter and now-Trump ally, United Auto Workers President Shawn Fain, about President Trump's tariff agenda. She wasn't ready for his blunt response...
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/e28d11e9-3224-4278-8b92-1e14e05b4ecb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/e28d11e9-3224-4278-8b92-1e14e05b4ecb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Panic over Trump's ballsy tariff play was reflected in the markets today as well as on the left wing media networks who are committed to criticizing and delegitimizing every action the Trump administration has taken and will take in the future.
Some Democrats, such as Fain, are calling bullshit on this.
Collins pressed Fain during their interview on his praise for Trump's 25% auto tariffs that went into effect this week.
"We really have to look at reality and **[quit using fear tactics in talking about this,"](https://substack.com/redirect/e28d11e9-3224-4278-8b92-1e14e05b4ecb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Fain said.
Collins pushed back, "Your auto workers, maybe they're happy with the auto tariffs,... but what about when they are paying more for food and clothes and electronics? Are they worried about that?"
"Everyone is worried about it, but let's talk about the real problem here," Fain fired back. "The real problem isn't the tariffs, it's corporate greed!" He explained that the auto industry saw 35% price gauging during the pandemic because of opportunistic corporate executives, "It's a choice!"
"I heard this crying all day about he stock market," Fain continued. "A majority of Americans don't own stock. Working class people, 60% don't have any retirement savings! That's the crisis, that's what we need to be talking about!"
Collins played a video of Vice President JD Vance responding to Fain's support of Trump's plan, acknowledging that he had "trashed" the Trump administration in the past but now is "welcomed to the team."
**["Let's be blunt about this...](https://substack.com/redirect/e28d11e9-3224-4278-8b92-1e14e05b4ecb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** we disagree on a lot, but we agree on tariffs!" Fain responded to the clip.

Charlie Kirk **[made a liberal father see that his pro-Trump son has a point](https://substack.com/redirect/cfad9e92-f97c-4ecc-8931-9094d0bde62c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and he should listen to him rather than shoot him down during debates.

Many economists called the tariffs much worse than expected, and investors dumped shares in companies they predict will suffer most from what is effectively a business tax. In many cases that tax will be passed on to consumers.
“ This is a game changer, not only for the U.S. economy but for the global economy, ” Olu Sonola, Fitch Ratings’ head of U.S. Economic Research, said in a report. “ Many countries will likely end up in a recession. ”

Peter, When the very most senior Trump administration officials recklessly sent military secrets in an unsecured group chat that included a journalist for the _Atlantic_ , they didn’t just risk the lives of our brave men and women in uniform. **They likely broke the law.** The _Espionage Act_ prohibits the dissemination of national defense information. name: Katie Porter
subject: Trump’s still attacking government
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Governor 2026
body:
Tariffs aren’t the only thing he’s doing that will hurt our bottom line.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21486?t=1&akid=39613%2E3422442%2E_hkudJ)
Dear Derek,
Donald Trump is an expert at the art of distraction.
While we absolutely need to watch out for how Trump’s disastrous tariffs are destabilizing our economy, we can’t take our eyes off his dangerous dismantling of our government either.
One example I’ve been thinking about lately is his cuts to a federal program that helped school districts buy fresh produce from local farms.
Students benefit from having nutritious food, which helps them learn better. Farmers benefit from having consistent buyers for their products. We _all_ benefit from having a well-educated workforce that can power our economy for decades to come.
**Donald Trump’s reckless cuts hurt all of us. The only ones who gain are his rich cronies, who are chomping at the bit for tax giveaways—at the expense of everyday Americans.**
We need leadership that is laser-focused on making life better for working people. That’s the kind of governor I’ll be.

name: AOC
subject: They're relying on us giving up
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
What the MAGA movement wants is for all of us to give up and say, “America has gone to hell in a handbasket, and we’re done.”
**No.**
If you are a hard-working, innocent person: **I have got your back**.
If you are just trying to make it in this world: **I’ve got your back**.
If you’re not trying to hurt anybody: **I got your back**.
It’s so important that we affirmatively assert that because, now more than ever, there are a lot of people who don’t know who they are safe with.
But when we speak up, we signal to others that there are people in this world who have not given up.
There are times when we are _not_ in positions of greater power, and sometimes what we are able to do is very limited. But even in times when our hands are tied, **one of the most enormously powerful things we can do is keep the light on**.
Don’t let these people’s bullsh*t get you down. What is so important for us to understand is that as long as we don’t give up, **it’s not over**.
We’re going to keep standing with trans people.
We’re going to keep standing with the LGBT community.
We’re going to keep standing for the working class.
We’re going to keep fighting for a better minimum wage.
We’re going to keep fighting to guarantee healthcare.
They’re relying on us giving up. **Hell no**.
We will not be afraid – because that’s what they want.
We do not have to comply with illegal activity — **even if that illegal activity is coming from the President of the United States.**
[Help us continue the fight with a grassroots contribution today.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250404.VtBwcb&refcode=em20250404-8531-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=8531%2E2526796%2EOYOUMv)

Alexandria

name: Justice Democrats
subject: Tariffs or billionaire bribes?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Donald Trump’s far-reaching tariffs went into effect yesterday. By
themselves, they threaten to tank the entire economy and cause the costs
of living to skyrocket.

By imposing these tariffs, or taxes on goods the U.S. imports from other
countries, without properly taxing the rich, reigning in Wall Street, or
implementing policies to promote manufacturing here in the United States,
the Trump administration is essentially raising taxes on everyone except
billionaires.

During the 2024 election, we heard over and over again that the main
reason people voted for Trump was to cut the costs of living, because the
reality is that even though the economy was strong on paper, far too many
regular people were still struggling to get by.

But we know that was never Trump’s intention. He’s now doing the exact
opposite, threatening both the economy and further raising prices for
everyday people without investing more in American jobs, workers, and
industries. There’s no denying that it’s going to hurt a lot of people.

The reality is that Trump, Elon Musk, corporate executives, and
billionaires don’t give a shit about working-class people.

They don’t care if the cost of milk, a used car, diapers, or the
medication we depend on increases drastically from one day to the next.

Because they don’t think about those things — with the amount of money
they have amassed by exploiting working people, they don’t have to.

Now, they get to wait for the corporate lobbyists and international
oligarchs to bribe their way to protection. Trump and his billionaire
friends get to line their pockets, corporations get to buy a pass, and
working class people are caught footing the bill.

This half-baked agenda isn’t about bringing jobs back to America, it’s
just another get-rich-quick scheme from the corporate and billionaire
class.

This is exactly why we need more everyday people in Congress who can
legislate from their own lived experiences — not just how Wall Street says
we’re doing in the stock market.

We’re recruiting progressives from working-class backgrounds to run and
unseat out-of-touch members of Congress in the upcoming 2026 midterm
elections. But since our organization and candidates don’t take a penny
from corporate PACs, our success depends on grassroots resources from
everyday people like you.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250404?refcode=em20250404-36560&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36560_1203867_5OcVsP&akid=36560%2E1203867%2E5OcVsP ]We understand if you can’t afford to make a donation right now, but if
you can, pitch in anything you can spare to directly fuel our work
electing working-class leaders who will actually work for us.

And no matter what, you can still get involved to elect the next
working-class champion for your community by nominating a leader for
Congress on our website.

Together, we can build the Party we deserve to represent us in Washington.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20250404-36560-footer&t=1002&refcode2=36560_1203867_5OcVsP&akid=36560%2E1203867%2E5OcVsP

name: Justin Kwasa, LCV
subject: REMINDER: Hands Off Rally tomorrow. Find one in your area:
body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTIzMzcxNjES1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjIwMDA2ODI5MwS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
I wanted to reach out to remind you that tomorrow is the nation-wide Hands Off! Day of Action.We’re uniting with over half a million people in over 1000 locations across the
country to say Hands Off! and fight back against Trump’s unprecedented power
grab. Tomorrow, we say Hands Off Our Public Lands! Hands Off Clean Air and
Water! Hands Off Clean Energy! Hands Off Our Environment! Click here to find your nearest event and get more info about the day of action. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/~NwYf4A6WAh2/d21IRk13eTZudkt4TER3aGQ0a0VYSzdZZWNaL24zRlZ3VTZ4cGZYWUFxSmI2eGNKajFBYytIWTJDSjE5bjBiV2JwbHZ5WFArZ1hhWGo0TmRrVkkrazdBUU8vZ0VINnZhY3JOMGdONU1HTjg9S0/ Justin Kwasa
Democracy Program Director
League of Conservation Voters Hi Peter, In the whirlwind of the first two months of this Trump administration, we’ve
seen unprecedented attacks on our environment, our health, and the very
foundations of our democracy. Trump and Elon Musk are working around the clock
to dismantle the protections that keep us safe, steamroll past constitutional
checks and balances, and cut essential services to pay for tax breaks for
billionaires and corporations. We can and must come together in defiance of the Trump-Musk billionaire takeover
and the Republican assault on our freedoms and our communities. This is an
all-hands-on-deck moment — and LCV and our partners have many upcoming
opportunities for you to join in the movement and make your voice heard no
matter where you live. SATURDAY, APRIL 5, NATIONWIDE — HANDS OFF! DAY OF ACTION

We’re uniting in over 600 locations across the country to say Hands Off! and
fight back against Trump’s unprecedented power grab. On April 5, we say Hands
Off Our Public Lands! Hands Off Clean Air and Water! Hands Off Clean Energy!
Hands Off Our Environment!
Click here to find your nearest event and get more info about the day of action. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/6Lg6BPjv_jtD/d21IRk13eTZudkt4TER3aGQ0a0VYSzdZZWNaL24zRlZ3VTZ4cGZYWUFxSmI2eGNKajFBYytIWTJDSjE5bjBiV2JwbHZ5WFArZ1hhWGo0TmRrVkkrazdBUU8vZ0VINnZhY3JOMGdONU1HTjg9S0/ THURSDAYS THROUGH MAY 15 — RISE FOR FREEDOM TRAINING SERIES

Are you looking for ways to help your community learn how to organize
effectively under autocracy? Our partners across the movement are coming
together to provide practical organizing skills you can hone right in your
living room. Topics include effective outreach, de-escalation, mutual aid, and
even more advanced strategic skills.
Click here to sign up for these trainings. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/ambdF6pAZpCP/d21IRk13eTZudkt4TER3aGQ0a0VYSzdZZWNaL24zRlZ3VTZ4cGZYWUFxSmI2eGNKajFBYytIWTJDSjE5bjBiV2JwbHZ5WFArZ1hhWGo0TmRrVkkrazdBUU8vZ0VINnZhY3JOMGdONU1HTjg9S0/ We can’t afford to let Trump and Musk take us backward on energy, put our
economy and our future at risk, and continue their assault on our democratic
institutions. But when we work together, we can mount a truly powerful
opposition even in the face of some of the most outlandish threats to our
democracy we’ve ever seen. I hope you can join us for any or all of these events, and I’ll keep you updated
with more opportunities to stay engaged. Justin Kwasa
Democracy Program Director
League of Conservation Voters This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. name: Senator Vincent Hughes
subject: REAL ID Information Session, April 9th at 11AM
body:
On the Issues from Senator Vincent Hughes

*Hands Off Social
Security*

*Senator Hughes brought federal, state, and local
lawmakers, union leaders, and community members together outside the
Social Security building in West Philly to tell Elon Musk and DOGE-
keep your hands off social security!*

[image =
http://enews.senatorhughes.com//images/user_images/Picture1_2.jpg]

*We
want Musk and DOGE to Keep Their Hands Off Social Security**

Over
2.9 million Pennsylvanians receive social security, yet Elon Musk has
mentioned multiple times that he thinks the program is a Ponzi scheme
[link 1]. He has claimed that the program is full of fraud [link 2],
but that claim has been proven false again and again [link
3].

*WATCH: Senator Hughes says social security helps people afford
rent and groceries*

[image =
http://enews.senatorhughes.com//images/user_images/Picture2.png] [link
4]

*Enough with Elon's Lies**

When we hear lawmakers and Musk
say "there will be no cuts to social security" they are not telling
the truth. At Senator Hughes' press conference [link 5], union leaders
explained how job cuts and office closures are already having an
impact on wait times and the level of service social security
recipients are experiencing.

DOGE and the Social Security
Administration have announced that leases for 47 Social Security
offices across the country will be ended. They have also announced
plans to cut thousands of jobs. It's easy to see how all of these cuts
and closures will make it harder for people to access their
benefits.

Already, the Social Security website has crashed multiple
times this year. And the system that monitors customer service was
cut- part of DOGE's "efficiency" efforts.

*Our Voices Will Make the
Difference**

[image =
http://enews.senatorhughes.com//images/user_images/Picture3_2.jpg]

We
must come together as a collective community to let Musk and President
Trump know we see what they're doing, and we will not stand for
it.

Social Security provides money that seniors, children, and the
disabled rely on to pay their bills, buy medication, and pay for
groceries. Social Security is the primary source of income for about
40% of older Americans. We cannot let one unelected billionaire break
down a program that millions of Americans have earned and rely
on.

*Call Your Congressperson**

[image =
http://enews.senatorhughes.com//images/user_images/Picture4_1.jpg]

Make
your voice heard!

Call Senators Fetterman and McCormick, and your
US Representative and tell them to stop Musk and DOGE from making any
more cuts and harmful changes to social security.

----------------------
footnotes
----------------------
[link 1]
https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/politifact/2025/03/24/is-social-security-a-ponzi-scheme-fact-checking-elon-musk/82593939007/

Peter, today marks the day Martin Luther King was assassinated.

I was 12 years old at the time, but I remember it like it was yesterday. It was around the same time I began attending an integrated school for the first time. The news of MLK’s death brought about a profound sense of uncertainty.

But instead of giving up on the fight for freedom, we came together to ensure MLK’s legacy would carry on, and that his call for non-violent resistance would lead us to a brighter future.

And today, I’m calling on all of us to reaffirm our commitment to upholding the eternal values of equality, peace, and justice in the name of Martin Luther King.

The 12 year old me hearing the news on that terrible day could never have imagined growing up to serve as your Congresswoman. It’s because of the work of Martin Luther King and so many other brave leaders that helped make it possible. And now I’m dedicated to continuing that work, because it’s far from over.

We’re living at a time when political divisions run deep. But as we continue our mission for justice and equality, I hope you will heed the words of the late Dr. King: “We must accept finite disappointment, but never lose infinite hope.”

Thank you,

Valerie Foushee

| | | [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.nTQp_FEIcSHl649vCJCicgFl4-m14JFRBrcYNYwfP9JIvmBnHU0VGpOT6rptE2SR6E78Ff5HQrMYZCajUoqbkOsfAEZQMwkF7Ez2d79gy1HYnpV-6Zb6QTwzR5_nufz1GlgPcXbH_ij8rK0s52dRifUejLrcT92nENPiGXGBoSGuA142z0q3tSeIvbrsobwO7Y1LD30-f1iIP1fACMyDqWH911quKBfzFRkGsJlzWd4_3ge17S1OVx3TzIzaQtLgsX0fwtu7WWUALEgnRG5b8wghiB-Va2keA41yNpxArC1H2iV4srMNUN8Dy0srm2l8/4fd/WH8RmsakRQu4ajz7C4zD1g/h0/h001.VlFvM_tgwEzIhVJbOqEZSL3h2KFy0qGB7y8SgF5_kBo) Peter, It is no secret that our region faces a homelessness and affordable housing problem. Metro has pushed forward and we set a goal in 2020: move 5,000 people off the streets and prevent 10,000 people from falling into homelessness. **So far, more than 700 new shelter beds have opened in the Region, joining the 2,200 that were opened before the launch of the supportive housing program.** And while the three Counties have surpassed those goals by moving 7,000 people off the street and responding to 15,000 eviction prevention requests, homelessness increased substantially during COVID. We have made progress, but reducing homelessness continues to be a major challenge. **We need to do more.** **Next up, two priorities:** **First:** Providing shelter is an urgent and substantial part of the solution measure, which is why the Metro Council is increasing our support to the city of Portland's plan to set up overnight shelters. But giving folks a better option than sleeping on the street is just one piece of the puzzle. **Second:** Along with shelter, our neighbors need access to critical services: mental health treatment, addiction recovery, medical care, and workforce training. We're going to **strengthen** and **reform** the supportive housing program to make those services easier to use and continue those services after folks move into permanent, stable housing. Decreasing homelessness in the Region works when the whole community – cities, counties, organizations, and neighbors – work hand in hand. **The Metro Council is reforming the system so it is more efficient and more people-centered for long-term success.** On top of that, we want to make it more accountable to you, the taxpayer. We will be adopting a series of reforms this spring and invite you to get updates and follow our work. **The biggest challenges our communities face don't stop at city lines or county borders.** Metro has a unique opportunity and responsibility – as the only regional elected body to bring people together across cities and counties to solve problems. As public servants, advocates, and neighbors, we will address homelessness together by demanding more from our system and challenging the status quo in ways that build long-lasting results. Together, _Lynn Peterson, Christine Lewis, Juan Carlos González_ _P.S. U.S. Sen. Katie Britt (R-Montgomery) is pushing Congress to pass legislation that will facilitate the completion of the wall at the southern border while also minimizing the cost of the project for American taxpayers.

The WALL Act, reintroduced and sponsored by the Alabama lawmaker, would appropriate $25 billion to finish building the wall without raising taxes on U.S. citizens or increasing the national debt. It would be funded through the closure of loopholes and the elimination of taxpayer-funded entitlements and tax benefits for people who are in the United States illegally. Additionally, the bill would impose monetary fines on people who come into the country illegally or overstay their visas.

U.S. Sen. Katie Britt is one of nine co-sponsors of the Kids Off Social Media Act, which limits access to social media for children under 13 and requires the platforms to implement certain restrictions.

Britt accused the social media companies of knowingly using harmful algorithms to lure young teens onto their platforms, which has led to a "mental health crisis."

"We know those algorithms are used against our children between the ages of 13 and 17," Britt said Tuesday on Newsmax's "Chris Salcedo Show." "We've said you don't get to use those against our kids. They're impressionable; they're young. We want to put up the proper guardrails that allow them to explore and grow, but to do so in a safe manner."

Senator Katie Britt, R-Ala., joined Senator Tim Scott, R-S.C., and several of their colleagues in introducing the Stop Antisemitism on College Campuses Act, which would rescind federal funding from colleges and universities that encourage antisemitism or facilitate antisemitic events on campus.
This legislation comes as the Department of Justice, the Department of Health and Human Services, the Department of Education and the General Services Administration recently announced the cancellation of about $400 million in federal grants and contracts to Columbia University due to the school’s continued inaction in the face of persistent harassment of Jewish students.

Katie Britt (R-Montgomery) is pushing Congress to pass legislation that will facilitate the completion of the wall at the southern border while also minimizing the cost of the project for American taxpayers. The WALL Act, reintroduced and sponsored by the Alabama lawmaker, would appropriate $25 billion to finish building the wall without raising taxes on U.S. citizens or increasing the national debt. It would be funded through the closure of loopholes and the elimination of taxpayer-funded entitlements and tax benefits for people who are in the United States illegally. Additionally, the bill would impose monetary fines on people who come into the country illegally or overstay their visas. | | Britt pushes age requirements for social media — 'There is a mental health crisis amongst young people in America' U.S. Sen. Katie Britt is one of nine co-sponsors of the Kids Off Social Media Act, which limits access to social media for children under 13 and requires the platforms to implement certain restrictions. Britt accused the social media companies of knowingly using harmful algorithms to lure young teens onto their platforms, which has led to a "mental health crisis." "We know those algorithms are used against our children between the ages of 13 and 17," Britt said Tuesday on Newsmax's "Chris Salcedo Show." "We've said you don't get to use those against our kids. They're impressionable; they're young. We want to put up the proper guardrails that allow them to explore and grow, but to do so in a safe manner." | | Sen. Friend, Mahmoud Khalil is still illegally detained, and since his abduction the Trump administration has been detaining and deporting even more immigrants, including students, professors, and workers with valid visas and permanent residency status. **Trump’s administration has:**
* **Deported Dr. Rasha Alawieh** in violation of a judge’s orders. The Brown University professor was blocked from re-entering the U.S. after visiting family in Lebanon.1
* **Kidnapped Rumeysa Ozturk** , a PhD student at Tufts University in Massachusetts, taking her to Louisiana in violation of a judge’s orders.2 Surveillance video shows masked, plainclothes ICE agents surrounding and handcuffing her in broad daylight before putting her in an unmarked car.
* **Revoked the student visa of Ranjani Srinivasan** —a Fulbright scholar pursuing a PhD at Columbia University—**and Badar Khan Suri** , a PhD student and teacher at Georgetown University whose wife is a U.S. citizen.3,4 Badar is still detained and Ranjani fled the country in fear after ICE came to the student’s home.
* **Took and tortured Fabian Schmidt** , a permanent resident who’s lived here for 17 years, as he returned from a trip abroad.5
* **Held Jasmine Mooney** , a Canadian with a valid U.S. work visa, for two weeks**** in “freezing-cold jail cells” with no explanation.6
* **Tried to deport two brave students who are now suing the Trump administration** : permanent resident Yunseo Chung and visa-holder Momodou Taal.
* **Deported Kilmar Armando Abrego Garcia to El Salvador’s notorious torture prisons** , in violation of multiple judges’ orders.7 A brother, father, and husband of U.S. citizens, Abrego Garcia had protected status that prevented him from being sent to his home country of El Salvador, where he could face persecution. ICE admitted to what they called an “administrative error,” but oppose his return to his family.

None of these people have been accused of any crime in association with deportation. **Regardless of immigration status, all residents of the United States have constitutional rights like the right to free speech and the right to due process.** Due process protections are meant to block arrests if agents don’t have reasonable suspicion of a crime. Due process requirements include proper notice of an immigration hearing, the ability to advocate and present evidence on one’s behalf in court, the right to a neutral rather than partisan judge, and the right to legal counsel in deportation proceedings. **Trump’s administration is testing out anti-democratic power grabs and violating our due process rights.** Secretary of State Marco Rubio says he’s monitoring student visa holders’ social media posts and aiming to deport people who criticize the U.S. government. Then they might come for anyone who criticizes Trump, including citizens. **We must stop this fascist repression immediately and make sure it doesn’t spread even further.** [**Please sign to tell Congress, federal courts, and the U.S. Marshals Service: Defend our due process rights from Trump’s attacks, and do your duty to prevent the president’s fascist repression NOW.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38bacrXqz-CH_FIlv0-54amCNmAJj07ewsBTrSWFnSaeGoxy2Ba8YfsqQ7OE_g-8y0Hk_a_zt3vz5AYGweBAH-QSr7WTjB6v6dVKRIjh4MV4-GhysfacC0-2CfjH-tJYtt2CFwhfsJGKiSu8EQ6sw-71iklV5E1VDbAtOFPWLm-PZs6iRcXOSn5DvALMamtWmy8X17MeOnwUembpcwT_y61Pd5KFr-Hy5efrPuVTb_a-c48h2YUSQ_jWIAzTiuRjOaKMNer29kwIhELlIlVj11NawCBTXN1twswXK2BVSkU216yzlTIPpVMWfgWveI5J2luU_n5Itp1waExACsZU93zPkel2E-RTQ90Wr3bPkYzVckDYlyXjXA_9Qk4C2yoe44BgJKO8AvyrXJh5Kf5JjS0zntsiubyFx0tPaEJLKvGT6gu9KpZhAtY2BM_aDKdzukPvga1oOw_O-TujbfJgJmtPjOrBLxcpJg1GbfHCRz7zWb3e0hCB973oLyde7i62m4/4fd/_CFPwSL3RgWZacSiN8q0xg/h1/h001.di_kxipqXnfkdEMv4ilJEmFB1f633x2tJmkDVmNY7us) | [SIGN ON](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38bacrXqz-CH_FIlv0-54amCNmAJj07ewsBTrSWFnSaeGoxy2Ba8YfsqQ7OE_g-8y0Hk_a_zt3vz5AYGweBAH-QSr7WTjB6v6dVKRIjh4MV4-GhysfacC0-2CfjH-tJYtt2CFwhfsJGKiSu8EQ6sw-71iklV5E1VDbAtOFPWLm-PZs6iRcXOSn5DvALMamtWmy8X17MeOnwUembpcwT_y61rGyGgqswwJxwMnZ9v1u0bGkfCt_2fv8ZYSOagIjPaX_Kz34FlIIC_UIQQj-Ki4uNmqCBXfTEk5YwM7kKachljdSmo1aKdPF7hvKwTICn9eOCeNZXCbbgURWkS7odQxK6M8ecOiSk3_PrDFC0a8jMbY_QeLUKo4VBCo0aQhZ6ioSasD6CBnx6IHcsn_y1XCOBBzvIlqwQcLIw71pxu1cXWYWMBjvq4hOlZC2jSnSmX0Y6uX3Gt9_aCOyAoiiTwKS7XXxd0fgQ9Qfa6WuaOVBoQjW2TwkyIR10mVx0f4hJiJM/4fd/_CFPwSL3RgWZacSiN8q0xg/h2/h001.OW1bZzgVdyV7W4M_arOMywg8SIkZN9v9M-Lp3_Tew3A)

Trump keeps violating court orders, including an order to block his deportations of hundreds of immigrants to El Salvador’s notorious torture prisons without any due process. He even threatened to impeach the judge who issued that order. **These unprecedented actions undermine one of the most fundamental principles of our democracy: the constitutionally mandated system of checks and balances between branches of government.**
The judicial branch (courts) is an important check on the legislative branch (Congress) and executive (president) branch of government. Congress and judges act as checks to presidents’ power. When federal judges block Trump’s unconstitutional actions, they’re doing their duty and their job.
The U.S. Marshals Service is the group designated to enforce federal court orders. Unfortunately, the U.S. Marshals Service reports not only to the courts, but also to Trump’s Department of Justice. Trump’s Attorney General Pam Bondi has openly defied court orders, lying to the public by claiming that it’s unconstitutional for judges to block Trump’s (illegal) actions. The opposite is true.
**If the fascists in power can violate court orders and laws without consequences now, they will come for others** ,**including people speaking out for lifesaving services like Medicaid, people advocating against police brutality, and others who are exercising their free speech rights.**
Already, Customs and Border Patrol has denied entry and even detained numerous tourists after checking their phones and finding criticism of Trump—prompting countries like Germany and the UK to issue travel warnings about the United States. And the Department of Homeland Security emailed hundreds of students with visas, stating that their visas have been revoked and threatening them with deportation to countries other than their country of origin.8

Recently I emailed you about one of the cruelest, most harmful ideas that I’ve heard in all my years at the Tennessee legislature: a group of bills all aimed at denying children in Tennessee a public education based on their immigration status. As I said last week: that idea defies logic, basic human decency, and also Supreme Court precedent set over forty years ago.
I’m writing again to you today to plead with you: join me in sending the message that no child should be denied an education simply because of where they’re from .
Here’s how:
* Join me in Nashville Monday, April 14th at 12pm CT [https://secure.everyaction.com/214XXG77S0uLSiaIZU1scg2?ms=GloriaJohnson] for a day of action to defend our children’s freedom to learn, and the public schools they count on. As recent protests have shown [https://www.wkrn.com/news/tennessee-politics/tuition-payments-undocumented-students-in-public-schools-dies-senate-cmte/?utm_source=facebook.com&utm_campaign=socialflow&utm_medium=referral&fbclid=IwY2xjawJKaPhleHRuA2FlbQIxMQABHYzdk3YLdtskbARBM_BZOGP2jcmzdg_gk6473oWvx4cjmrWkko7QwIFjhQ_aem_8JZyGpRjO0btm2hQrUd07Q] , there is strength in numbers and showing up matters . We will keep you posted when additional votes are scheduled, and we will invite you to join the growing chorus of demonstrators at the Capitol – but we need you April 14th!
* Volunteer Virtually this Saturday, April 5th at 4pm CT [https://www.mobilize.us/mobilize/event/772657/] : Volunteers from across Tennessee will come together to reach constituents of undecided lawmakers, sharing crucial information about what's at stake and exactly how their calls and emails can make an impact.
* Volunteer on your lunch break [https://www.mobilize.us/tappactioncouncils/event/757146/?utm_source=GloriaJohnson] to provide supporters in districts of lawmakers with the information they need to influence them: April 4, April 11, and April 18.
* Call your lawmakers [http://educationforalltn.org/call/?ms=GloriaJohnson]
* Email your lawmakers [http://educationforalltn.org/email/?ms=GloriaJohnson]
Since I last wrote, this bill passed another hurdle with a majority vote in the House Education Committee, where I proudly represent Knoxville and do my best to represent ALL Tennessee families. But make no mistake: together, we can still stop this . Notably, a number of my Republican colleagues have voted against these bills at every stage and brave Tennesseans are showing up in increasing numbers to protest these bills.
And just last week a ten-year-old courageously confronted bill sponsor Rep. William Lamberth (R) and other committee members by kneeling and repeatedly chanting, "Stop attacking my friends!" as demonstrators sent the message that “ going after children, when they've done nothing wrong, is a betrayal of the Christian values these lawmakers claim to stand for .”

And just last Sunday hundreds of parents, children, faith leaders all turned out in bill sponsor Sen. Bo Watson’s home town to send that message even louder.

As always, I’ll be standing tall for ALL of Tennessee’s children, and I thank you for standing with me!
Gloria

| | | Peter, We’ve got a LOT of exciting news to share from the past month, so we put together this April Newsletter just for you! Keep reading to catch up on our recent wins and updates for the fight ahead.
* * *
### _Acing the First Electoral Tests of 2025_
In the last month, WFP champions across the country faced the first major electoral tests of the year — and voters turned out en masse to show their support! **This Tuesday in Wisconsin,** Democrat Susan Crawford won a landslide victory for State Supreme Court over MAGA extremist Brad Schimel. This win means that the court will hold on to its liberal majority, protecting abortion rights, workers rights, and voters rights across the state. Elon Musk dumped tens of millions of dollars into this race, showed up at rallies, and tried to bribe voters for $1 million each, but the people of Wisconsin refused to let him buy this election and instead handed him an embarrassing defeat. We’re so proud of the organizing from the Wisconsin Working Families Party, who executed one of the largest spring field programs ever, resulting in:
* 25,606 1-on-1 conversations with voters via canvassing and phones.
* 703 volunteers sending 36,868 personal postcards to voters.
* A $15,000 paid digital ad campaign to reach our targeted voter audience with messages around public safety.
* And overall, we reached out to voters 661,330 times, had 44,841 successful conversations, and identified 15,408 voters for Judge Susan Crawford.

**Last month in Maryland,** voters cast their ballots in special elections for County Executive and Council in Prince George’s County, the largest in the state. Both of our WFP-endorsed candidates, Aisha Braveboy and Shayla Adams-Stafford, won important victories — securing a progressive majority that can take on housing affordability and support the county’s many federal workers under attack from the Trump administration. Wins like these are only possible because of WFP members like you who donate their time, energy, and resources to electing champions for working people at every level of government, and taking the fight directly to the billionaires. **[Help us keep going:](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9D5qDaq26IF8-OYFDKADUgmaceKY4iKpG3nKUXZJ66mZLPIV6g52x6xnusDYnzatJ2wGUGYHF4wjiRCu4SRqtNCK_AZyFCyeqEp4h-SLjaTowT5aD-cyLVmJzyjXMQo94636fLtkjkvK2DdfRn8rgmq8BzQr4e9yf2s2FNwNkPkB3gGZx_Cdq-Vf5FMe2W7lTbE_aTEh9wmrz4OiIwGTzvCyyWwVxUKVJm3mfanjd3akL-eZmxH2yxpRcAetL4nnMv_KL7OMmcB9aCZi9uOO5zFfInF6XpLvt25X2IV_vvTIPAs7IV2ZHRDFZNY0QJez8_OdpyFXJzpP_2UrS_YVzEg/4fd/3oCQ9b0uSM2j898bJRFnRw/h0/h001.8bcXjXaA0qssVnIByitejh70I21W_sxou2-Nxpq0Kc4)** **[Donate](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9D5qDaq26IF8-OYFDKADUgmaceKY4iKpG3nKUXZJ66mZLPIV6g52x6xnusDYnzatJQ76QNxWoKxpiLte_WqWRduFvNoMHeO6EGliXkayuffvNpPl6TtwXYl-5ga7uffqQLTHFdeB_s6ICajBxmOd4GtBozEzfTQTAww3aD8Pza3K_hQRp3EjZfMTSvUWJCJKigIpPCodGhGpQh1xX4c9OTc_isY9RTQsJWmiHEEAKbYFCs0pwgBx8RWpZAs-JTfBD34CtVk7KAiJNN2CZ1G7u0OtLNnFHEYuG4F7EafaD3fPow1DOtfwtVdzcwEn1qVpKWr1dYDKnvXrdfcBQRPJVOA/4fd/3oCQ9b0uSM2j898bJRFnRw/h1/h001.w-n6JPSbF3SMpAAn_mi4FIbmmgP0_49Rx3qeO-p8jeE)**

### _Congressional Recess Report: “Empty Chair” Town Halls_
Members of Congress went on recess last month — and WFP members and Working Families Power went to work holding them accountable. Thousands of people joined “empty chair” town halls for representatives who are too afraid of their own constituents to even hear their questions. Here are some highlights:
* **Arizona** — Despite narrowly winning his last re-election with exactly 50.0% of the vote, Rep. Juan Ciscomani has hid from voters and refused to hold in-person public town hall meetings. **We’re proud to support four bold progressive leaders — Adrienne Adams, Brad Lander, Zohran Mamdani, and Zellnor Myrie — in the June election for New York City Mayor!** New York City uses ranked choice voting in mayoral elections, meaning that voters can rank multiple candidates in order of preference. ### _Member Spotlight: Ujjval Patel_
[](=?link_id=18&can_id=12471c8e444f80358077c9724aea85a0&source=email-your-april-newsletter-3&email_referrer=email_2685556&email_subject=your-april-newsletter&&) I believed in the American dream growing up because of my immigrant family. My parents worked multiple minimum wage jobs and saved each penny over two decades to buy a small business. It was a source of pride in our family, but, as I got older, it felt infuriating. My parents’ employers preyed on them as non-English speakers and underpaid them for years because they could not leave their job easily. Working families like mine struggle to survive, and we have so many problems that we need to solve and are solvable, but the current system prioritizes the status quo. WFP is different. WFP is focused on building power from the ground up and they are willing to work through the current conditions to get great candidates elected. Working families need a bulwark for them and WFP shows me they are committed to being that through the strategic actions they are taking and the policies they are focusing on. The 2024 election was the straw that broke my back. I knew I had to jump off the sidelines I joined some WFP Welcome Gatherings and listened. At one Welcome Gathering, they talked about Wolf Packs, small, action-oriented groups of leaders who take on specific roles to grow WFP membership and amplify our national activist work. I decided to do some research and found a YouTube clip with WFP National Director Maurice Mitchell talking about them. He said something that stuck with me: Our relational capital is the most powerful capital on this planet. I decided to raise my hand to be a Wolf Pack leader. I can talk to my friends, family members, and co-workers and build on our trust and connection to address issues that concern us. I can help convince them to get off the sideline to vote and build power. It is easy to get lost in the quicksand that is doom scrolling, thinking about how messed up society can be. The Wolf Pack members energize me and show me there are folks that care in the community that I live in. I am sure many of them will become lifelong friends.

clean_body: | | | Peter, We’ve got a LOT of exciting news to share from the past month, so we put together this April Newsletter just for you! Keep reading to catch up on our recent wins and updates for the fight ahead. Acing the First Electoral Tests of 2025 In the last month, WFP champions across the country faced the first major electoral tests of the year — and voters turned out en masse to show their support! This Tuesday in Wisconsin, Democrat Susan Crawford won a landslide victory for State Supreme Court over MAGA extremist Brad Schimel. This win means that the court will hold on to its liberal majority, protecting abortion rights, workers rights, and voters rights across the state. Elon Musk dumped tens of millions of dollars into this race, showed up at rallies, and tried to bribe voters for $1 million each, but the people of Wisconsin refused to let him buy this election and instead handed him an embarrassing defeat. We’re so proud of the organizing from the Wisconsin Working Families Party, who executed one of the largest spring field programs ever, resulting in: 25,606 1-on-1 conversations with voters via canvassing and phones. 703 volunteers sending 36,868 personal postcards to voters. A $15,000 paid digital ad campaign to reach our targeted voter audience with messages around public safety. And overall, we reached out to voters 661,330 times, had 44,841 successful conversations, and identified 15,408 voters for Judge Susan Crawford. Last month in Maryland, voters cast their ballots in special elections for County Executive and Council in Prince George’s County, the largest in the state. Both of our WFP-endorsed candidates, Aisha Braveboy and Shayla Adams-Stafford, won important victories — securing a progressive majority that can take on housing affordability and support the county’s many federal workers under attack from the Trump administration. Wins like these are only possible because of WFP members like you who donate their time, energy, and resources to electing champions for working people at every level of government, and taking the fight directly to the billionaires. Congressional Recess Report: “Empty Chair” Town Halls Members of Congress went on recess last month — and WFP members and Working Families Power went to work holding them accountable. Thousands of people joined “empty chair” town halls for representatives who are too afraid of their own constituents to even hear their questions. Here are some highlights: Arizona — Despite narrowly winning his last re-election with exactly 50.0% of the vote, Rep. Juan Ciscomani has hid from voters and refused to hold in-person public town hall meetings. Although he refused the invitation when he was invited to a town hall meeting by Honest Arizona, LUCHA, Working Families Power and other local partners, so that constituents could voice their concerns about his lack of leadership. California — The last day of recess, Rep. Ro Khanna held a town hall tour co-sponsored by Working Families Power of three GOP-held districts in California (CA-22, CA-41, and CA-45). You can and including remarks from WFP-champion local elected official Visalia school board trustee Randy Villegas (remarks begin at 24:26). New York — While Rep. Mike Lawler is a frequent fixture on cable news, he’s largely avoided meeting with his constituents. So this past weekend, Rockland Indivisible and the Westchester-Putnam Working Families Party held to discuss how the proposed GOP budget would affect families in NY-17. New Jersey — Congressman Tom Kean Jr. has been one of the most elusive members of Congress in the country. While he has refused to meet with his constituents, Rep. Bonnie Watson Coleman joined Citizen Action New Jersey, Working Families Power, and other local community groups to and explain just how devastating proposed Medicaid cuts would be. Pennsylvania — In Pennsylvania, Working Families Power has been working closely with local partners like SEIU to hold Reps. Mackenzie and Perry accountable for their votes to cut billions from Medicaid, and recently co-sponsored events in both districts to hear from constituents. including of a constituent whose son was fired from the Department of Education, and Wisconsin — In Wisconsin, Working Families Power co-sponsored a town hall with Wisconsin Secretary of State Sarah Godlewski, where she took questions from constituents that Rep. Derrick Van Orden is too scared to answer. The event was covered both and We refuse to let our elected officials hide from the people they’re meant to represent. Throughout the year, working families will continue to speak truth to power and demand answers in return. 1000+ Working People Sign Up to Run for Office with WFP! Our billionaire-backed political system isn’t going to change itself. We need people in office who come from working class backgrounds — who know what it’s like to work hard day in and day out for a paycheck that doesn’t always pay the bills. That’s why last month, we announced one of our most ambitious goals in WFP’s history: to recruit more than 1,000 working-class candidates to run for office at every level of government across the country. We were inspired to see that more than 1,000 of you have already signed up! If you believe our government should work for everyday people, not just the wealthy and well-connected, and are ready to step up and lead — now might just be your time, Peter. Our plan is to provide guidance, training, and resources to elect more working people at every level of government, including local offices that all too often get ignored. Can you make a contribution to ensure we have the resources to give these working class candidates the support they need and deserve? Hands Off! Join the Biggest Protest since Trump Took Office on Saturday This Saturday, April 5, more than 1000 protests will be held across the country with workers, students, seniors, veterans, immigrants, and everyday families coming together to say: Hands off our services. Hands off our rights. And hands off our communities. Working Families Power will be co-sponsoring the national Day of Action, because we’ve all seen that every person in the streets makes our message louder, our movement stronger, and this fight impossible to ignore. NYWFP Releases NYC Mayoral Endorsement Slate We’re proud to support four bold progressive leaders — Adrienne Adams, Brad Lander, Zohran Mamdani, and Zellnor Myrie — in the June election for New York City Mayor! New York City uses ranked choice voting in mayoral elections, meaning that voters can rank multiple candidates in order of preference. The candidate with the lowest number of votes each round will have their support transferred to the voter’s next choice, until one candidate has 50% of the votes or higher. By ranking all four of our endorsed candidates, NYC voters can keep progressives united and maximize the chance to elect a Working Families champion who fights for all of us. to learn more about our strategy and each member of our mayoral slate. Then, stay tuned! We’ll be releasing a proposed ranking as the election gets closer. How We Fight Back: Subscribe for More Info on How to Defeat the Trump Agenda! Working Families Power has launched a new publication with allies at MoveOn and Indivisible to give people concrete ways to organize against the daily overreaches of the Trump administration. The “How We Fight Back” Substack will feature leaders from Working Families Power, MoveOn, and Indivisible sharing practical advice, sharp political analysis, and easy ways to plug in. My parents worked multiple minimum wage jobs and saved each penny over two decades to buy a small business. It was a source of pride in our family, but, as I got older, it felt infuriating. My parents’ employers preyed on them as non-English speakers and underpaid them for years because they could not leave their job easily. Working families like mine struggle to survive, and we have so many problems that we need to solve and are solvable, but the current system prioritizes the status quo. WFP is different. WFP is focused on building power from the ground up and they are willing to work through the current conditions to get great candidates elected. Working families need a bulwark for them and WFP shows me they are committed to being that through the strategic actions they are taking and the policies they are focusing on. The 2024 election was the straw that broke my back. I knew I had to jump off the sidelines I joined some WFP Welcome Gatherings and listened. At one Welcome Gathering, they talked about Wolf Packs, small, action-oriented groups of leaders who take on specific roles to grow WFP membership and amplify our national activist work. I decided to do some research and found a YouTube clip with WFP National Director Maurice Mitchell talking about them. He said something that stuck with me: Our relational capital is the most powerful capital on this planet. I decided to raise my hand to be a Wolf Pack leader. I can talk to my friends, family members, and co-workers and build on our trust and connection to address issues that concern us. I can help convince them to get off the sideline to vote and build power. It is easy to get lost in the quicksand that is doom scrolling, thinking about how messed up society can be. The Wolf Pack members energize me and show me there are folks that care in the community that I live in. I am sure many of them will become lifelong friends. Derek, Right now, it’s our responsibility as Democrats to challenge Trump’s lies, confront his reckless agenda, and communicate to voters all over the country that we can _offer a better alternative._ With your help, that’s exactly what we’re doing — take a look: **_Breaking: DNC Chair Ken Martin Launches “People's Cabinet” to Fiercely Counter Trump Administration Chaos and Lies_** Today, the DNC announced a new project: The People’s Cabinet. This project brings together qualified policy experts, national and local leaders, and voices from our communities — people who will cut through the lies and speak directly to Americans about the reality of what the Trump administration is doing. The People’s Cabinet will include a wide array of national, state, and local experts on the economy, health care, working families and communities, public safety, and national security and foreign policy — including former Labor Secretary and co-founder of Inequality Media Civic Action Robert Reich, former Acting Labor Secretary Julie Su, former Wisconsin Lieutenant Governor Mandela Barnes, and more. In order to reach as many people as possible and meet them where they are, the Cabinet will conduct briefings with media and coalition partners, speak directly with Americans at town halls, produce digital content to reach people across the platforms where they get their news, engage in rapid response to counter the lies and disinformation from the Trump Administration, and serve as thought leaders for the Democratic ecosystem on effective strategy and tactics in countering the worst of the Republican agenda. **We heard from thousands of people earlier this year that you want to see Democrats aggressively countering Trump, while reaching voters where they are, year-round. That’s exactly what we’re working to do.** [**This work is only possible with your help. If initiatives like these are important to you, we hope you’ll consider pitching in a few dollars to help fund the work we’re doing:**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-april-2025?amount=3&refcode=em_20250404_3150_fr&refcode2=3150_22930333_GYIDQZ&akid=3150%2E22930333%2EGYIDQZ) **[CONTRIBUTE $3](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-april-2025?refcode=em_20250404_3150_fr&amount=3&refcode2=3150_22930333_GYIDQZ&akid=3150%2E22930333%2EGYIDQZ)** Thank you, and we’ll have more updates to share soon. The Democrats

Hi Derek, it's
Adam. I was moved by this message from Cory Booker's mother, Carolyn, and
I wanted to share it with you. Please read this message, then [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=abs-em-booker25.gMTtR1&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20250404_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=8445%2E5257348%2EZd1__0 ]show your
support for Cory by splitting a contribution to our campaigns.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Derek, I'm
Carolyn Booker, Cory Booker's mother.

I’ve said before: behind every successful child is an astonished parent.
This week was certainly no exception.

I know Cory cares deeply about the people he represents, I know he is
passionate about the future of this country, and I know (maybe better than
anyone) that he can talk for hours on end — but I was still astonished
about just how well he can demonstrate all of those things.

When Cory was sworn in as Senator, I reminded him of an old phrase: “It’s
not titles that honor people, but people that honor titles.”

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=abs-em-booker25.gMTtR1&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20250404_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=8445%2E5257348%2EZd1__0 ]Cory and Carolyn Booker

I have had the honor of witnessing and participating in historic moments
in my life — from attending Fisk University during the civil rights era
with Diane Nash and John Lewis, to participating in the sit-ins protesting
segregation in Charlottesville and Nashville in the 1960s, to helping to
plan the March on Washington in 1963 and hearing Dr. King tell the world
about his dream.

I was honored to watch this historic moment, and to watch Cory bring more
honor to his title.

Just like his speech, Cory’s campaigns and activism have never been about
himself, but about lifting up others and their stories.

I am so proud of my son, and I am so grateful that so many in this country
are still willing to stand up and speak out for the values we believe in.

With love,

Carolyn Booker

name: Sarah McBride
subject: Why I spoke on the House floor
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
This is about meals on the table.
#
Food banks nationwide are facing an urgent crisis, including in Delaware.
I recently spoke on the House floor to call out the Trump administration’s cruel and unnecessary decision to abruptly halt millions of dollars worth of life-saving food deliveries to food banks.
These deliveries provide millions of meals for families, seniors, and veterans who rely on food banks to get through the month.
This aid is not abstract — it’s meals on the table.
**In February alone, more than 50% of the food the Food Bank of Delaware distributed came through the USDA.** Now, with shipments frozen and no clarity on whether they will be restored, food banks are being forced to stretch already-limited resources even further.
At a time when grocery store prices remain high and demand for food assistance is great, the loss of these shipments could mean fewer meals for families.
**The Trump administration continues to break its promises to the American people — not just with words, but with real-world consequences for people who are already struggling.**

clean_body: This is about meals on the table. Food banks nationwide are facing an urgent crisis, including in Delaware. I recently spoke on the House floor to call out the Trump administration’s cruel and unnecessary decision to abruptly halt millions of dollars worth of life-saving food deliveries to food banks. These deliveries provide millions of meals for families, seniors, and veterans who rely on food banks to get through the month. This aid is not abstract — it’s meals on the table. In February alone, more than 50% of the food the Food Bank of Delaware distributed came through the USDA. Now, with shipments frozen and no clarity on whether they will be restored, food banks are being forced to stretch already-limited resources even further. At a time when grocery store prices remain high and demand for food assistance is great, the loss of these shipments could mean fewer meals for families. The Trump administration continues to break its promises to the American people — not just with words, but with real-world consequences for people who are already struggling. In solidarity, Sarah McBride

body:

| | Dear Fellow Believer, It may seem a little early to be talking about Easter, but it's really only weeks away. And in that short amount of time, my friends at Brave Books are spearheading a massive "Prepare the Way" campaign to shift the focus of Easter from bunnies and chocolate... ...to Jesus. And this revival mission needs you! My friend, if you've seen me talking about Brave Books on Fox News, you know their mission is to counter the ungodly lies being pushed by the Left in schools, libraries, and Hollywood... ...by creating high-quality, wholesome, and Godly books and entertainment that instill conservative values and Gospel lessons in our children. And their "Prepare the Way" revival campaign is their biggest effort yet to point parents and children to the empty tomb and God’s redeeming love. Here’s exactly what their strategy is... First... Brave Books knows that families need an easy and impactful way to counter the Left's secularization of Easter and instead, captivate children with its true meaning. So, they created _Saving the Easter Bunny_ , a brand-new children's book that's destined to be a classic. In it, Ronnie the Rabbit learns the hard way what sin is and that our Lord Jesus Christ loves us so much that he took the punishment for that sin. Jesus is represented by a powerful lion named Lord Joshua and the book beautifully portrays his resurrection and God's never-ending redeeming love for us. It's incredible. And let me tell you, parents are hungry for content like this because everywhere they turn godlessness is being pushed by schools, left-wing publishers like Scholastic, and Hollywood. When Brave Books first introduced a God-centered Christmas game called "_Mouse in the House_ ," to counter the secular elf game that has become so popular -- it sold out in THREE HOURS! That's why step one of Brave Books' "Prepare the Way" revival, is ramping up the printing and distribution of _Saving the Easter Bunny_ big-time. **[And today I'm hoping you'll help them kick it into high gear before orders start pouring in by rushing back your best "Prepare the Way" gift.](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=su7v98&__onlt=h)** No family should go without this wonderful book because of overwhelming demand. Second... Recognizing that families who want to raise their children with wholesome Christian values often feel alone in their mission... Brave Books is launching a 17-city traveling church tour that starts in Ponta Vedra Beach, Florida and ends in Laurel, Mississippi. I'll be leading the tour in every city as we prepare our hearts and our families for Easter through prayer, worship, music, and just some good old-fashioned conversation about raising Godly children in our godless culture. Our church tour aims to ignite a spirit of revival in thousands of families this Easter season and I can't wait to see what God makes of that! But getting our worship teams, musicians, and all the rest to 17 different cities for thousands of families to enjoy won't be easy and it won't be inexpensive. But I know we can do it. Brave Books is a small Christian company founded by a doctor named Trent Talbot. After having his first child, he saw how the Left was using books and entertainment to turn the hearts and minds of America's children away from God. And so he decided to take action and with the help of believers just like you, look at what they've already done:
---
>>> They've countered the Left's radical and ungodly "Drag Queen Story Hours" and filled children's hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God with their highly-publicized "See You at the Library" campaign. Armed with Brave Books' "See You at the Library" kits, thousands of parents, grandparents, children, and concerned citizens have gathered at over 360 libraries in 49 states to take back our libraries. >>> Created an historic TV show called "Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk" to fight the ungodly lessons coming out of Hollywood. It's our modern day "Mr. Rogers' Neighborhood" funded by everyday Americans who want to return American culture to God. "Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk" uses humor and storytelling to reinforce the traditional biblical values that have made America great. >>> And now you are crucial to the success and failure of our "Prepare the Way" revival campaign which features the printing and distribution of _Saving the Easter Bunny_ and a 17-city church tour.
---
And listen to this... **[**Your "Prepare the Way" gift of $35, $50, $100 or more, not only helps fund this revival campaign that makes Jesus the reason for the Easter season once more...**](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=su7v98&__onlt=h)** Your gift helps Brave Books complete a groundbreaking comprehensive homeschool curriculum that gives parents an alternative to woke government schools. AND your gift helps Brave Books begin work on an historic Gospel book series that will bring the Bible to life for a generation of children and parents in desperate need of God's truth. But nothing Brave Books accomplishes is possible without you. And if you need one more reason to help, when you **[contribute $100 or more to the "Prepare the Way" revival](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=su7v98&__onlt=h)** , Brave Books will send you _Saving the Easter Bunny_ absolutely free as a thank you. You can keep _Saving the Easter Bunny_ for your family, gift it to someone you love, or you can donate it to your favorite charity in the hopes of reaching a family who doesn't have a Christian role model in their life. **[**What's most important is that you rush back your best "Prepare the Way" gift of $35, $50, $100, or more right away.**](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=su7v98&__onlt=h)** Thank you for bringing the true meaning of Easter to families all across America.
---
May God bless you this coming Easter season,
---

body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/081043af27eb/media-advisory-canepa-sheriff-removal-procedures-take-shape-but-will-be-a-measured-and-transparent-process415-513-9410?e=c0babbc643)
---
| |
---
| | April 4, 2025
Press statement
Supervisor Canepa contact: (415) 513-9410 _**Canepa: Sheriff removal procedures take shape but will be a measured and transparent process **_ REDWOOD CITY – San Mateo County Board of Supervisors President David J. Canepa made the following statement today as two items on the Tuesday, April 8 Board of Supervisors meeting agenda will enable the beginning of “Sheriff Removal Procedures.” “I want to make it crystal clear to the public that the Board will not be initiating removal procedures Tuesday,” Canepa said. “We are merely considering, providing direction to staff and seeking community feedback on how the removal proceedings may be conducted moving forward. The earliest the Board may approve the final removal procedures will be April 22 which will ultimately trigger a series of actions the Board will take to notify the Sheriff of the intent to remove and then to allow the Sheriff to respond to the allegations. This will be a measured and transparent process that will be fair to the Sheriff, who deserves due process.” On Tuesday, the Board will accept the statement of results from the Chief Elections Officer certified Thursday indicating 84% of voters supported Measure A, which gives the Board the power to remove the Sheriff with cause until 2028. The statement of results is on the consent agenda and will likely be approved prior to the Board’s regular agenda. The second item is a recommendation by the County Attorney’s Office to consider and provide direction on draft procedures for conducting a removal proceeding pursuant to Section 412.5 of the San Mateo County Charter. A link to the agenda is here: [https://sanmateocounty.legistar.com/View.ashx?M=A&ID=1234911&GUID=A35343E4-5B29-4168-8A50-181266DBCBA4](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=2d09524d6e&e=c0babbc643 "https://sanmateocounty.legistar.com/View.ashx?M=A&ID=1234911&GUID=A35343E4-5B29-4168-8A50-181266DBCBA4") A link to the Board memo and related documents on removal procedures is here: [https://sanmateocounty.legistar.com/LegislationDetail.aspx?ID=7293193&GUID=128ECE4C-49CB-4EA9-A7F0-E9E792EAF334](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=87e0d3c771&e=c0babbc643 "https://sanmateocounty.legistar.com/LegislationDetail.aspx?ID=7293193&GUID=128ECE4C-49CB-4EA9-A7F0-E9E792EAF334")

"Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk" uses humor and storytelling to reinforce the traditional biblical values that have made America great. >>> And now you are crucial to the success and failure of our "Prepare the Way" revival campaign which features the printing and distribution of _Saving the Easter Bunny_ and a 17-city church tour.
